Kallona yayi alokacinda yakai ramar bakinshi yace "kinma sani ashe shine kike tambayana?" tura baki nayi gaba sannan nace "inason in tabbatar ne,Ina sune?" yace "Sune Ƴar birni,kuma yakamata kizama ɗaya daga cikinsu sabida zaifi suiting ɗinkin. Lord! You can bombard questions" tsuke fuska nayi nace "ni basu nakeson inzama ba" da mamakina yace "kaji wanda bokon ke jininsu,ashekarunki harkin gama deciding mezaki zama?" jijjiga kaina nayi alamar a'a yace "toh kince ba journalist kikeson zama ba it means you've something in mind" nace "masu samo gwal kaman ku nikeson zama banaji Aunty jidda tace kuna samo gwalagwalai ba?" wata iriyar dariyane tazo mishi daya sashi kusan kwarewa,dakyar yayi controlling kanshi yace "Wai yau kikayi deciding abunda kikeson zama?" gyaɗa masakai nayi ahankali innocently sannan nace "inason insamo ma Gogode da Gwaggo Suwaiba sarka da dankunnen gwal suna sakawa kamar yanda nake ganin yan Film na gayu dashi" dariya yake sosai yanzu nace  "zaka koyamin yanda ake samowa?" yasake kwashewa dawani dariyan yace "sede sukoya miki. nimena sani Ƴar birni?" Cikeda yarinta nace "toh munabin abokanan ka mukoya kaga se insamo ma su gwaggo Suwaiba nasu gwal ɗin kaima kasama ma Aunty jidda" yana dariya yanacin kwaɗon ramarshi yace "toh Ƴar birni haka za'ayi" bawai don maganar tawa takai mishi harkasan zuciba...

Dayagama cin abincin tare mukaje nacika kwaryata da kanya,muka zauna agurin mukasha iya shanmu sannan muka kamo hanyar gida bayan mungama planning zece aikafar daina ciwo tayi dakanta shiyasa yatafi yawo kuma duk nina kawo wannan idea ɗin. dafari cemin yayi beyarda ba,inyace yasamu lafiya it means gobe dole yabi abokanansa kenan wanda alokacin nikuma nadage firrr semun bisu ɗin don sununa mana yanda ake samo gwala gwalai,danaga yaki yarda nace "toh zanfaɗa ma kowa ciwon kafar karya yakeyi" dolenshi ya yarda dani,abunka dasanin halin yaro yasan tsaf zan iya.

***
Ranar murna kaman zanyi yaya,duka mutanen gidanmu sedana zirara musu labarin zanje samo gwal ma Gogode da Gwaggo Suwaiba washegari haka kawayena ma duk seda nafaɗa musu damuka hadu a dandali da dare. Adaren kuma natakurama Gogode seda tasa Baffana yaje gidanmu yakarbomin jeans da riga da canvas ɗina gurin Baba ni adole inason inyi dressing irinnasu Lamido.
Bayan nadawo daga dandali nasamu har ankawo min kayana,a ɗaki nasamu Baffa na da Gogode suna magana sede suna ganin nashigo ɗakin sukayi shiru basu ƙara cewa komaiba.

Baffa ne yayi karfin halin ɗauko ledan kayan daya karbo min daga kan gado yamika min yayinda Gogode taƙi ko kallon inda nake,nade ga tanata rurrufe fuskarta da gyalenta. cikeda murna nakarbi kayan ina tambayar Baffa Babana yacemin "Lafiyar sa kalau" nace masa "rashin lafiyar shi bekara tashi bakoh?" ahankali Baffa yace min "eh" kafin yatashi yafice adakin bayan yamana saida safe.

Nikadai naita surutaina dukdai akan maganar tafiyana neman gwal gobe Gogode najina ko uffan batacemin ba harna gaji nahau gado nakwanta bacci.

( _The story of Rukayya_ )

Washegari kuwa tun karfe biyar natashi nafara shiri,bakaramin mamaki Gogode tayiba ganin dakaina natashi ranar wanda ada se anjima anatashina kafin natashi nayi sallar asuba,wataranma harsai gari yafara haske zantashi inyi sallah, inakuma idarwa zankoma inkwanta bacci harsai Indo tatashi tafiya surfe take tashina inshirya mutafi tare.

Kan gari yayi haske harna gama shirina cikin farar t~shirt dayasaukamin kaɗan se blue jeans wando,na saka white hijab ɗina karami(half sunna),na kwama white canvas ɗina na School danake zuwa sport dashi every Tuesdays and Fridays dayazame mana ranakun sport.

Ko abinci ƙin ci nayi daman ɗanwake akayi kuma ba mutumina bane tun asali. Kofar gida naje nazauna kan wata yar karamar benci ina kalle kalle ko Allah zaisa inga bullowar su Lamiɗo. every morning daman Baffanaina da gidansu baya haɗe dana Gogode sukanzo su gaidata suji yata kwana,toh haka yauma kuma dukwanda yazo shiga gidan yaganni zaune kamar wata angulu me jiran tsanmani seya tambayeni zaman menakeyi se ince masu "tono ma Gogode da Gwaggo Suwaiba gwal zanjeyi taredasu Lamiɗo" wasu suyima yarintata dariya wasu kuma suce suma insamo musu har dai Baffah Ade yazo yasamoni. 

Da mamaki yake kallona bayan nagaisheshi yace "harkun shirya tafiya kenan?" batareda nagane meyake nufi ba nace masa "eh jiransu nikeyi suzo mutafi" yace "Toh madallah. Allah yakara lafiya" nace "Amin" batareda naɗauki furucin nasa dawata manufa ba, tambayana yayi ko Gogode naciki nace masa "eh" daganan yashige abunsa. niduk bansan wainar da ake toyawa ba,inanan inata farin ciki da nishaɗi,inanan inata zumuɗin  zuwa nemowa Gogode da Gwaggo Suwaiba gwal sabida sune mutane mafi soyuwa araina bayan Babana,ashe Baba yanacan kwance gadon asibiti rai ahannun Allah. Ashe tunjiya da Baffa Idiii yaje karbo min sako yatarar babu yanda yake,yana kwance agida yanata fama da ciwo batareda yanada me kula dashi ba wanda shi Baffa Idiin ne dayaje yaga halin dayake ciki yayi gaggawan fita yasamo taxi suka ɗauke shi suka kaishi asibiti akuma take akayi admitting ɗinshi,yabarshi da makocinmu da shima baisan baida lafiyar ba yanazaune kofar gida yaga Baffa Idii yafito riƙe dashi shine yataso hankali tashe yataimaka mai suka kaishi asibitin tare.

Dayake yasan gidan Kawunaina straight can yawuce yasanar dasu halin da mahaifina yake ciki shine suka ɗunguma sukayi asibitin hankali tashe. ayanda nasamu labari Baba dakanshi da Baffa zaidawo Babban buli yadinga roƙonsa kada abari insan bayida lafiya,hankalina zaitashi shikuma duk abunda zaitadamin hankali bayaso,yafison inkarashe hutuna cikin Jin ɗadi da walwala bayason abunda zaisani cikin damuwa. Shi ya roƙi Baffa Idi daya tafimin da saƙona da aka turashi karba wanda hakan yasa Baffa komawa gidan yaɗauki saƙona sannan yadawo Babban buli hankali tashe yasanar da Gogode halin da ake ciki,yakuma shaida mata abunda Baba yace gamedani shiyasa dukansu suka boyemin wanda haryau bana tunanin sunyimin adalci,haryau banajin zan iya manta siezing precious times ɗinda sukayimin dayadace inzamanto ina tareda Baba. bantaba sanin inlokaci yatafi baya dawowa ba hakanan bantaba yarda da cewa da ake opportunity comes but once ba se bayan da narasa wannan opportunity ɗin wanda bani dakaina naguji opportunity ɗinba,Yan uwana sukamin siezing daga gareni wanda atunaninsu wannan ne kaɗai zaisani farin ciki bayan kuma bahaka baneba.

Maganar da Baffa Ade yamin kafin yashiga gida ashe shirin tafiya asibiti ake agidan duk ni bansani ba. jira kawai suke Lamiɗo suzo mutafi tare kafin suma sukama nasu hanyar dukda dafari Gogode kallona kawai takeyi dan dasafema seda akayi artabur da'ita tareda su Baffa idiii data tambayeshi "tayaya zasu samu sutafi asibiti batareda nasani ba" Baffa Idiii yace "Ina daman tanata shirin bin baki zuwa neman gwal insunzo sun tafi basai muma muje asibitin mudawoba?" Take Gogode tafara hawaye tace "Daman ku duk maganar nan sokuke yarinyar nan tabi baƙin dabamusan asalinsuba? bamusan daga ina sukeba fisabilillahi?" Baffa Idiii yace "munsansu mana Gogode, ɗalibainefa dasuke zuwa daga Gombe kuma abokina ma yanacikin masu sharar filin makarantar ATBU kuma da bakinshi yace min anan suka sauka,dagaske ɗalibaine kuma kowani shekara suna zuwa kawai yankin mune baki taba gani sunbiyo ba se yan shekarar nan" anma furrr Gogode taƙi tace "ina dukansu maza ne? ta'ina kukeson inhaɗa su da jikata a irin zamanin damuke cikin nan?" marairace fuska Baffa Idiii yayi sannan yace "Gogode inbata bisu ba tayaya zamu boyema Ru'eyya batun rashin lafiyar Umaru bayan yaroƙi kada abari tasani? kuma indai batun maza ne akwai mace ɗaya cikinsu namiki alkawarin zanbata amanar jikarki nidamuwana ɗaya shine kada Ru'eyya taji labarin rashin lafiyar mahaifinta kamar yanda ya roka,yakuma sakanayi masa alkawarin ƙin faɗa mata harzuwa lokacin dazai samu sauƙi "

Jin waɗannan maganganun daga bakin Baffa Idiii yasa Gogode hakura tace "to shikenan tayarda".

Inazaune kan benci wuraren takwas da ƴan mintuna haka sega su Lamiɗo sun bullo dukansu cikin shirinsu kamar kullum,hanyar gidansu Hari sukayi don karbar fura da nonon dasuka ce a ajiyemusu zasu saya dasafen nan sutafi dashi field wanda abakin Hari naji labarin jiya da dare takumace dayanma ma sunkarbi wanda sukace a ajiyemasu suka sha anan kofar masallaci sukayi sallah kafin suka wuce bakin hanya. dagudu natashi nashige gida ina kwala kiran Gogode,a rumfar kofar ɗakin ta nasameta zaune sanye da sabon kaya da alama wanka tayi tashirya zataje wani guu anma excitement ɗin tafiya neman gwal bebarni natambayi inda zata ba cikin yaren fillanci nace "Gogode mai yotti mindo dilla jonta ma (Gogode sun iso zamu tafi)" Gogode duban Baffa Idiii tayi sannan tace "sekaje kabada amanar tata kamar yanda kace zakayi ai" gyadakai yayi ahankali tareda kama hannuna yana faɗin "muje Ru'eyya" bye bye nama Gogode kafin muka fice agidan.

Akofar gidansu Hari muka samesu sunata miƙa gorunan daza'a dura musu nono da furar tasu bayan andama banda Lamiɗo. wanda naji sunƙira da Auwal ranan ne yafara ganina sakan baki yayi yana nuna musuni yace "wancan ba Ƴar birnin Lamiɗo baceba?" take dukansu sukajuyo suna kallona Lamiɗo dake zaune kan wani gungumen itace yana kallon yanda suke miƙa gorunan ana zuba musu fura da nonon yayi saurin tashi tsaye donshi yama manta deal ɗin mu najiya inba yanzu daya ganni ba.

Sakin hannun Baffa Idiii nayi naruga inda yake tsaye da gudu ina murmushi nace "Ina kwana" yace "Lafiya Lau young geologist" tura bakigaba nayi ina mashi kallon bangane meyake nufi ba nace "Young geologist?" Jan kumatuna yayi ahankali yace "eh mana,sunan da ake kiran duk masu karanta wahalalliyar course ɗin kenan and you're young shiyasa nakiraki da *Young geologist* murmushi nayi cikeda Jin daɗi sannan nace "har kayansu ma gashi nasaka" Lamiɗo yace "Kuma sunyi miki kyau ba,duksekika fimu fasalima anya gwalagwalannan bake zasu gani sufara fitowa dakansu ba Ƴar Birni?" dariya su Uztaz sukayi Auwal yakaraso inda muke tsaye nida Lamiɗo yace "Ƴar birni ce takoma young Geologist yaukuma?" Lamiɗo na dariya yace "eyi wai taji ance ƴan Geology ketono gold shine tace zabimu ta nemoma Gogode da Gwaggo Suwaiba gwal tanason suyi kwalliya irin yanda taga matan film nayi. tanason suzama yan gayu sumaaaaaww" yakarashe maganar yana rawa funnily,dariya suka dingayi wa yarintata da abunda Lamido yayi nikuwa se washare hakwara nayi nace "aitare zamu nemo bakaima zaka samona Aunty jiddah ba?" Yace "eyi anma ai inbansamu ba kikasamu zakibata koh? Tunda kince kinason tazama yayarki" Cikin sauri nace "eh zanbata se inraba musu su uku" shafa kaina yayi ahankali yana dariyar yarintata haka Baffa idi dake gefema harsuka gama amsan fura da nonon suka shirya tafiya.

Baffa idi yaƙira su duka yacemusu nadage sena bisu suyi hakuri sutafi dani kuma yabasu amana na,suɗaukeni kamar kanwarsu duk inda zasuje su tabbatar Ina taredasu. Lamiɗo yace "indai wannan ne bakada matsala Baffa. insha Allahu zamu kula da Ƴar birni" godiya yamasu yakama hannuna yasaka cikin na Faith yace "kece mace Ƴar uwarta nasankuma zatafi sakewa dake,dan Allah ga abokiya namiki kikula da'ita" murmushi Faith tayi tanasake riƙe hannuna tightly sannan cikin ragwababbiyar hausarta tace "toh Baffa kerka damu. She'll be safe with us" daganan yasake musu godiya sannan yabar gurin Uztaz datunda ake maganar bece komaiba sabida Jin nauyin Baffa dayakeyi harsaida yatafi sannan yadubi Lamido yace "yanzu fisabilillahi alkawarin daka daukar ma yarinyarnan ka kyauta kenan? ta'ina zata iya tafiyar wahalar dazamuyi fisabilillahi? she'll just be a burden and nothing else" 

Hafiz yakalli kafata yace "ga canvas ɗin tama babu grid ko dutsi bazaiyuyu tahauba kasani" Kabir dake gefe yace "Babu reflective jacket kuma ba and it's the most important sabida danger" duksenaji jikina yayi sanyi idanuna sunciko da kwalla Jin korafin dasukeyi,nafara tunanin kozasuce baza su tafi danidinba bayan nariga nagama kwallafa raina akan abun.

Tsugunawa a gabana Lamiɗo yayi yacire reflective jacket ɗin jikinsa yasakamin,yaciro abunda naƙira da irin wall clock ɗin gidanmu(compass clinometer) yasakamin a wuyana sannan yasa dogin yatsunsa yashiga goge hawayen dasuka fara jiƙa fuskana Faith daharyanzu take riƙe da hannuna tace "nibanga laifin Lamiɗo ba tunda bashi yace mata tabimuba,itadakanta taga munburgeta kuma tanason binmu shiyasa tayimashi magana. Kundai san halin yara da kafiya,tayaya zaifara cemata a'a? And it can also be awasa yaɗauki abun datace masa zata bimu yau dan kallon dayamata sanda tazo ɗazu nalura akwai mamaki a fuskarshi tunda tace zataje kubarta mana,she's just a kid" Uztaz yace "we're not disliking the fact that she's following us Faith,damuwarmu risk ɗinda ke cikin binmu dazatayi ne. ta'ina yarinyarnan zata iya tsawon tafiyar damukeyi? muda muke manyama kullum semun gasa kafafun mu tsabar gajiya bare ita. Amabar wannan maganar ta'ina zata iya hawan dutsi as young as she's? and most importantly canvas ɗin kafarta is not suitable for field work Faith"

Lamiɗo dake tsugune agabana bece komai ba tundazu yatashi tsaye yace "korafin Kabir na magance shi tunda gashi nabata nawa tasaka,naka korafin dana Hafiz suma zan magancesu. tunda ninacemata tabimu toh nine zanzama responsible for everything game da'ita so inma tsoro kakeji Uztaz ka kwantar da hankalinka insha Allahu babu abunda zaisamu Ƴar birni" daganan shida Faith sukayi gaba kowannensu nariqe da hannuna ɗaya. Su Auwal ɗin ma bin bayanmu sukayi daganan muka dinga nausawa cikin daji harsaida muka fara isowa inda duwatsu suke sannan Auwal yazo yashige gaba muna binshi abaya sabida shike riƙe da wani abu waishi GPS.

Kuma tunda muka fara isowa surrounding ɗinda duwatsun suke nalura shike bada directives yana faɗa musu hanyar dazasubi harmuka iso jikin wani madaidaicin dutsin dabashida wani tsayi sai faɗi daɗan tudu kaɗan. tsayawa yayi yana kallon cikin GPS ɗin sannan yace "Uztaz sake karantomin GPS reading ɗin jikin map Please" take Uztaz yakaranto mai sannan Auwal yace "we're at the location. nanne" gaba ɗayansu samun guri sukayi suka zauna suna ƙoƙarin ciro littafi da biro cikin jakarsu ayayinda Kabir yashiga tambayar location nawa suke banda Lamiɗo dake tsaye gefena yana rike da hannuna haryanzu.

Nidai bangane mesuke nufiba dan gaba ɗaya kaina yaɗaure,atunanina tonon gold mukazoyi toh mezai haɗa su da takarda da biro kuma? cikeda curiosity najuyo nakalli Lamiɗo dake tsaye yana kallonsu nace "A Ina zamu toni gold ɗin?" Ƴar dariya yayi sannan yadubi su Uztaz daketa kokarin rubata informations ɗinda Auwal ke faɗa musu cikin kananan books dinsu yace "Yar birni na tambaya" ɗagowa sukayi suna kallona yace "cewa tayi a Ina zaku toni gold ɗin ne wai?" dariya sukayi dukansu sunacigaba da rubutunsu,Faith tace "Zo Ƴar Birni" sakin hannun Lamiɗo nayi ahankali nakarasa inda take zaune gefenta tanuna min tace "Zauna toh" zama nayi sannan tacemin "miye sunanki?" Ina murmushi nace "Rukayya" duk maganar da mukeyi Lamiɗo na kallonmu.

Jin nace Rukayya ne sunana yasa yasaki baki harda riƙe haba yace  "laaaa ashe sunan wata Yar uwata gareki" dariya Kabir yayi yana jijjiga kai Lamiɗo yace "Allah kuwa. sunan maman kishiyar kakata kenan. Rukayya ba,tayi tenure kamar baza'a mutuba,itafa azamaninsu ko aljanu da mayu seda suka matsa gefe suka bata guri tsabar bokanci" Hafiz  na dariya yace "kace tayi tsiya?" Lamido yace "tayi dabbanci dai dan wanda zaiyi abunda yasaba ma ubangiji batareda yatuna ya lahirarsa zata kasance ba ai dabbanci yayi" Uztaz yajinjina kai sannan yace "hakane kam" Lamiɗo yazo yasamu guri yazauna yana ɗaukan kananan duwatsu yana jifa dasu ɗaya bayan ɗaya sannan yace "toh yanzu inama take? ina duniyar datake neman da abun cikinta duk tatafi tabarsu"

Kabir dake rubutu yaɗaga yana kallon Lamiɗo sannan yace abunda bamwa ganewa kenan. "Allah dai yasa mufi karfin zukatanmu mukuma yi kyakyawan karshe" "Amin" dukansu suka amsa da kafin Auwal yatashi tsaye yace "yanzu dai muyi abunda yakawomu nan muƙara gaba" Hafiz yace "Kai antabo maganar Allah da annabin ma bazaka ɗan sarara manaba fisabilillahi?" dariya Faith tayi yayinda Lamiɗo yace "Bokoh Boko! Ubansun kukeji" 

Tsaki Auwal yayi sannan yace "kuka sani dai" Uztaz na dariya yace mudai duba features ɗin kowa yafaɗi abunda yayi observing muyi concluding mutafi next location zaifi" nikuwa duk nagaji dasakani a duhun dasukayi danhaka nasake taba Faith attention ɗin ta yadawo kaina nace "a Ina zamu toni gold ɗin Aunty Faith?" dariya tafara yi wanda hakan yasa attention ɗinsu yadawo kaina.

Faith tace "Sorry my dear ɗazu inason baki ansa Lamiɗo yakatse ni daganan kuma namanta" tace "Rukayya nemo gold ɗin ba sauki bane dashi kuma bawai haka kawai akesamunsa ba a bagas,dole se anyi zurfi cikin karatu,angama gane kan Geologyn baki ɗaya kafin ake fara tunanin samun gold ɗin,muda mukenan dukanmu koyo mukeyi kuma muma bamuqi wataran musamu gold ɗin nan ba dukda kuwa samun shi abune maiwuya,in an samu ɗin ma ciroshi daga ma'adanarsa shima wani babban aikinne anmadai ai ba'a cire hope koh?" gyaɗa matakai nayi ahankali cikeda gamsuwa tace "toh with your hope and determination may be wataran ke kisamo mana gold ɗin a arewancin Nigeria" washare hakwarana nayi sannan nace "zan iya kuma?" trying as much possible to motivate me tace "sosaima. mezai hana?" nace "kuma innakoyi duk abubuwan dakuke koyannan shine zaiyi leading ɗina to samun gold ɗin agaba koh?" gyaɗa min kai tayi ahankali.

Marairace fuska nayi sannan nace "toh kuna koyamin abubuwan naku please. Inason insamoma Gogode da Gwaggo Suwaiba gwal watarana" dukansu couldn't help it seda sukamin dariya Auwal yace "for sure we'll teach you indai kinaso. duk abunda kika ga bakiganeba kitambayeni kinji?" cewa nayi "toh" kafin nashiga kallon gurin nace "inane nan?" Lamido dake kwance yanajinmu yace "zako kusha tambaya harsaikun gaji indai Ƴar birni ce dan kureku zatayi wallahi tallahi" Auwal yace "shine mekyau ai, people that are very curious are always intelligent because they always want to know new things" kafin yadubeni yafarayimin bayanin gurin tayanda zangane dakyau.

Yamin bayanin amfanin GPS ɗinda suke yawo dashi dasauran instruments ɗinda ke hannayensu duk seda yabi yamin bayani yanda zangane kafin yacemin a basement complex muke tsaye ma'ana environment ɗinda muke contains only igneous and metamorphic rocks wanda ake musu jimillah ace *Basement complex*. akwai sedimentary environment ma wanda babu shi agurin yace da akwai dayamin bayani akansu anma inda muken ma innasamu knowledge koda kaɗan ne zeyimun amfani in the future.

Briefly yagamamin bayani sannan suka fara observing gurin suna faɗan abubuwan dasuka gani inda se sun duba wanda points ɗinsa yafi karfi kokuma waɗanda maganarsu tafi rinjayar sauran sannan suke concluding susaka a report book ɗinsu,nikuma duk abunda nagani inason sanin menene sena tambayi Auwal dana lura shine shugaban tafiyar tasu ma'ana Lamiɗo yabarmasa ragamar komai as the group leader.

Haka muka dinga yawace yawace daga wannan location ɗin zuwa next location hakanan kowani location akaje se an ɗauki sample na gurin sabida nunama malamai. shidai Lamiɗo binmu kawai yakeyi don inaga awannan lokacin koni nafishi gane me akeyi tunda natsinci abubuwa ɗaya zuwa biyu dai haka. da an Isa new location yakesamun gurin yakwanta danshi ko Ƴar rubuce rubucen da sukeyima banga yanayiba hakanan innaga abunda nikeson sani natambayeshi seya dubi Auwal yace "mutumina miye wannan ama Ƴar birni bayani" shikuma Auwal babu bata lokaci zaiyi min bayanin in a way da abun bazaimin tsauriba iya dede shekaruna.

Seda sukaga karfe biyu tayi sannan suka samu karkashin wata bishiya sukace muhuta,ayi sallah aci abinci kafin mujuya gida. dukna gaji,kafafuna sunfara ciwo anma sabida banason gobe ahanani zuwa yasa nayi shiru naqi nafaɗa ma kowa dukda Faith da Lamiɗo nayawan cemin innaji nagaji inyi magana.

Sekunyi dariyaaaaaa,dariyaaaa dariyaaaa!!dariirii dariyaaaas!! Sekunyiii dariyaaaa" aikuwa segasu suna dariyar su Uztaz harda kyakyatawa....

Su Baffa dake zaune a rumfar masallacinma seda suka dara ga abunda Lamiɗon yayi,komawa yayi yazauna yacigaba da copying duk ina kallonsu kafin nakarasa na ajiye kwaryar agabanshi cikin yaren fillanci nace "Dado gogode vi miwaddana ma(gashi inji Gogode in kawo maka)" da mamaki yaɗago yana kallona cikin fillanci shima yace "Dofu mintan bi birni (Duk wannan nikadai Ƴar birni?)" gyaɗa masakai nayi ahankali cikin yaren fillanci yace "dakinyi kara ai kada abokanaina suji ba daɗi and they took very good care of you too. dakincema Gogode dukanmu muka kuladake bani kaɗai ba" nace "aicewa tayi inkawo maku nikuma danaga sunsaya shine nakawo maka kai kaɗai" yace "Toh nagode but don't do that next time kinji? akwai abunda ko ba'ace kayi ba sekayi shi don kayi kara" nace masa "toh" ɗaga kanshi yayi yace musu "Gogode tabamu fura" dayake basuji conversation dinmuba duk cikin fillanci mukayi aikuwa segashi sunnuna Jin dadinsu sosai,bakaramin murna sukayiba suka dinga godiya sunacemin ingaishe da Gogode.

Toh a ranar ne nasake sanin wasu daga cikin halayen Lamiɗo. Even though he's funny and jovial. he's very witty,ya'iya zama da mutane sannan yanada Kara dasanin yakamata.

Inabarin gunsu Lamiɗo straight gida nakoma nayi sallan la'asar sannan nazauna cin murucin da Gogode tasiyomana ina kallonta nace "Gogode gidan wa kikaje acikin gari?" adaburce tace "nibabu inda najeni" kallonta nayi na yan daƙiƙu sannan nace "Gogode bazanyi kuka dan baki tafi daniba sabida nafison binsu Lamiɗo akan binki nima" anma da mamakina se batace min komai ba tatashi tashige ɗaki tana matsar kwallah.

Tashi nayi zanbita cikeda damuwa Indo tayi saurin riƙoni tana faɗin "kada kijeki,batason surutu kantane ke ciwo tunjiya kibarta tahuta tukunnan" jiki sanyaye nakoma nazauna araina ina addu'an Allah yabama Gogode lafiya cikin gaggawa, because she's one of the most precious people in my life.

Da dare bandamu Gogode ba sabida ciwon kanda Indo tacemin takeyi,Baffa Idiii nasamu a kofar yadikko Rahane dayake harlokacin bata fita agirkiba,kwana bibbiyu yakeyima kowannensu dama. yana zaune cikin ɗakinta yanacin tuwo nayi sallama,ansamin Yadikko Rahane tayi tareda yimin iso.

ɗaga labulen nayi ahankali sannan nashiga nasamu guri nazauna ina gaida Baffa Idiii yace "A'a Ru'eyya ne daman" Ina murmushi nace "Eh Baffa. Ina wuni?" yace "Lafiya Lau ya yawace yawacen naku? babudai wata matsala koh?" cikin sauri nace masa "Eh Babu" Baffa Idiii yace "toh madallah,kungama ne ko gobema zaki sake binsu?" nace "bamugamaba dasaura" cikeda zolaya yace "se'ansamo gwal ɗin kenan" Yar dariya nayi sannan namasa bayanin abunda su Faith suka faɗamin gameda samun gold kafin daga karshe nace "Baffa zancigaba da binsu don inkoyi abubuwa da dama,wataran inason inzama kamarsu sabida insamo ma su Gogode gwal" yayi dariya yace "Allah yabada sa'a toh Ru'eyya" nace "Amin Baffa" kafin nakarada "daman Baffa abunda zanci gobe ahanya nakeson asiyomin" Baffa yace "mekikeso Ru'eyya?" kai tsaye nace *Nice biscuit* da *Caprison* dan sukaɗai zan iyacewa na riƙe sunayensu sabida irinsu Baba kesiyamin kwali kwali,sabida zuwa makaranta. kullum dasafe inzan tafi makaranta seya saka min cikin class bag ɗina,wani sa'in kuma *Viju* ko *Bobo* anma biscuit ɗindai kullum *Nice Biscuit* yake sayamin,wannan dai me blue leda ɗin.

Nan take nafaɗa ma Buba, Baffa yaciro kuɗi yabashi yace "kasayo mata kowanne guda goma goma tunda ba fitar kwana ɗaya zasuyiba,sauran kwanakin ma nasan zata nema. gwanda asiyo duka yanzu basai ansake komawa ba" bakaramin daɗi hakan yamin ba atleast zansamu inyi sharring komai nida Lamiɗo tayanda dukan mu zamu koshi.
Indo ce tawanke min kayana danayi amfani dasu ranar dansu zansake sakawa washegari kasancewar set ɗaya aka ɗaukomin daga gida.

Washegari kamar jiya dawuri natashi nagama shirina. Gogode ta aika aka karbo min nono da fura agidansu Hari kamar yanda nabukata dan gurin mu babu a ƙasa,ba'a tatsa daga jikin shanuba jiya da yanma yaukuma da sassafe suka tafi kiwo se yanma kuma zasu sake dawowa.

Ɗuramin nonon akayi a gora, naɗauki caprison guda biyu da Nice biscuit guda biyu nasaka aleda. sannan nasaka goran nonon ma cikin ledan biscuits da juice ɗin nawa,nazauna zaman jiransu agida dan nayi alkawarin se Lamiɗo yazo har gidanmu yagaida Gogode yau. Aikuwa wuraren takwas da yan mintuna sega sallamarsu abakin kofa, muryar sa danajine yasani tashi nafice aguje ina murmushi na nufi kofa. yauma different kaya yasaka kamar yanda yake canzawa kullum don tundaga ranar dana fara ganinshi harzuwa yau banga ya maimaita kayaba,he's always looking fresh and handsome. dukda kankantar shekaruna alokacin nasan Lamiɗo duk yafisu iya gayu gakuma kyau da Allah ya bashi,uwa uba abunka da jinin fulani. karasawa nayi inda yake tsaye Ina murmushi nace "Wali jam?" shima murmushin yasakarmin tareda jan kumatuna yace "jam kalau Ƴar birni" sannan najuya nakalli sauran suma nagaidasu suka amsa ayayinda Lamiɗo yace "Aina ɗauka bazaki ba yau dabanga kinfitoba" Auwal dake gefe yana murmushi yace "mukam har zamu tafi yace muzo gida muntambaya muji ko gajiyan jiya yasaki ciwon ƙafa ne" Ƴar dariya nayi ina kallonsa sannan nashiga swinging kafana nace "lafiyan kafata Lau fah. Gogode ta gasamin da ruwan dumi jiya da dare kafin mukwanta" Faith tace "inyeeeey babyn Gogode Ƴar gata" sa hannu na nayi ina rufe fuskata Ina dariya kaɗan kaɗan. Lamiɗo Jin haka yabata rai kamar gaske yace "Allah sarki ni, nida wahala wata dashan gata" cire hannuna nayi afuskata ina kallonshi tareda pouting bakina yace "Allah massage ɗinda akamiki da gasa kafafunki da akayi dukni yakamata ama tunda ninayi wahalar goyonki,gatawa gajiyar gakuma wanda kika ɗauramin" dariya nayi still ina kallonshi sannan nashiga jan hannunsa nace "muje tayi maka mana toh" kwace hannunsa yayi dasauri yana zare idanu yace "Keh wasafah nake miki" anma hakan behanani sake jaan hannunsa ba dolenshi yabini cikin gida,harkofan Gogode nakaishi inda muka sameta zaune cikin rumfarta Indo nagefenta tana ƙoƙarin ɗaukan ƙwaryar hatsi da alama surfe zata tafi.

Seda muka isa gaban Gogode sannan nasaki hannunshi nace "Gogode ga Lamiɗo wai shima ki gasa masa ƙafarsa irin yanda kikamin jiya da dare kafin nakwanta" Lamiɗo zamewa kasa yayi yana sussunkuyar da kai akunyace yace "Ina kwana Inna" inkaga yanda yake ladabi kamar bashine Lamiɗo meshegen surutu da rigimannan ba. Gogode fuska ɗaukeda fara'a tace "Lafiya Lau Lamiɗo. ya karatu?" Lamiɗo yace "karatu alhamdulillahi" Gogode tace "Madallah. mungode da wahala fah Allah ubangiji yasaka da alkhairi" Lamiɗo yace "mune da godiya Inna,jiya munga fura da nonon Allah yasaka da alkhairi"

Gogode na murmushi tace "Ayya kaɗan ne dai,babu yawa" Lamiɗo dai baikuma cewa komai ba sema murmushi datakeyi kanshi a ƙasa kamar wani mutumin kwarai. Gogode tace "aijiya danaga kafafunta sunyi tsami shine na gasa matasu da ruwanzafi kokaima za'ayi makane?" dariya Lamiɗo yayi yana shafa sumar kansa yace "a'a Inna wasa takeyi miki,kafana lafiyansalau" Gogode tace "aihakan akeso. Allah yakara lafiya,Ina sauran abokanan tafiyar taku?" tashi Lamiɗo yayi yace "Suna waje ba ince su shigo kugaisa" Gogode tace "toshikenan" daganan Lamiɗo yafita yashigo dasu Auwal sukazo suka gaisa da Gogode,tasakeyi masu godiya sannan muka tafi.

Daga inda muka tsaya jiya muka cigaba da mapping harsaida muka ƙarasa mapping ɗin wannan quadrant ɗin sannan muka shiga next quadrant wanda yawanci locations ɗinda aka basu suyi mapping awannan quadrant ɗin hills ne gurin gabadaya,dole sesun hau sunyi observing gurin sannan suɗauki sample daduk wasu information daya kamata. gaban katon hill ɗin muka tsaya dayagama kewaye gurin gaba ɗaya kowa nafaɗin albarkacin bakinsa nayanda za'a hau hill ɗin akuma sauko.

Auwal nafaɗin muhau adauki GPS reading da important informations daganan mutsallaka zuwa next location basai mundawo tanan ba kawai inda Uztaz kefadin bafa lallai asamu hanyar sauka tacan ba,inma za'a samu toh baya kusa dan kuwa hill ɗin nada tsayi,yazagaye gurin bakiɗaya.

Yayinda Faith da Kabir ke suggesting su haura suyi abunda zasuyi su sauko sukoma baya inyaso se sunemi wani hanyar. tunda muka iso wurin hill ɗin Lamiɗo yaga sunata musu sunkasa concluding miye abunyi yaja hannuna mukasamu kan wani madaidaicin dutsi muka zauna muna kallonsu. Hafiz dabaisaka baki a conversation ɗin tun ɗazuba yace "nidai shawarar su Faith shine the best dan inmuka ce zamuhau muɗauki sample munemi hanyar sauka tacan bakaramin wahala zamusha ba kamar yanda Uztaz yafaɗa and moreover yakamata kuduba da wanda muke tafiya, Ƴar birni bazata iya hawa dutsin nanba talkmore of anemi hanyar sauka tacan koma tananne duk ba'iyawa zatayi ba.

Lamiɗo dakejinsu tun ɗazu yace "aibama Ƴar birni kadaiba,koninan dakake gani bazan iya hawa wannan gundumemen dutsin ba wallahi. Dan ban shirya komawa gida da karyayyen kafaba,ah toh. daman kawai jinku nake. Ina jira kugama muse musenku Inna muraba hanyane toh kowa seya kama gabansa" Auwal yace "abun baikainanba Lamiɗo yanzu kawai kaida ita kuzauna anan barimu muhau muyi abunda zamuyi semu sauko muyi sallah semukoma baya munemi next lokacation. yaude semun gama quadrant ɗinnan zamu koma gida insha Allah" Uztaz yace "wannan shine solution kawai" daganan suka shiga ajiye jakakkunansu da other belongings ɗinsu sannan suka fara kokarin hawa dutsin. Munanan zaune muna kallonsu harsuka fara komawa kamar jarirai from our view tsabar tsayin da dutsin yakedashi inda daga baya kuma suka bace mana da gani.

Duban Lamiɗo nayi ganin nadaina ganinsu sannan nace "laaa nadaina ganinsu Yaya Lamiɗo" Yar dariya yayi sannan yace "cikin duwatsun akwai lumgu lumgu ai may be shiyasa bazaki gansuba anma insuka gama hawa dutsin may be mugansu. ko zaki kirasu kiji inda suke?" cikeda curiosity nace "Inna kirasu zasuji?" gyaɗa min kai yayi ahankali sannan yace "mezai hana?" nace "naɗauka sunyi nisa bazasujiba" Lamiɗo yace "kigwada kiransu kiji inbasu amsaba" nace masa "Toh" kafin cikin siriruwar muryata nashigakwala ma Auwal kira nace "Yayaaaa Auwaallllll! Yaya Auwallllll!!!" anma shiru cigaba da kira nayi still babu amsa,pouting bakina nayi kamar meshirin kuka sannan nasaka kaina cikin gwiwana inafadin "gashi basujiba" Lamiɗo daketa aikin yimin dariya tunsanda nake kwala kiran Auwalllll yace "yoh ta'ina zai amsa Ƴar birni?kinji muryarki kuwa? kamar an jijjiga bera a buta" yakarashe maganar yana sake kwashewa da dariya sannan yashiga imitating murya na yana faɗin "jifah yanda muryar taki tayi,Yayyyyaaa Auwalllll....Yayyaaaa Auwallll. haba koni danake gefenki muryarki bata razananiba bare har ace zekai inda suke" dagowa nayi Ina tura baki haryanzu sannan nace "toh ai iyakacin muryata kenan" dariya yakumayi sannan yace "yarinya kibiyani kiji muryar mazaje in one second. kira ɗaya zanyi musu su amsa" ashagwabe nace "banida kudin biyanka aitoh" yace "duk randa kika zama billionaire sekibiyani" atake nace "toh nayarda" kwalama Auwalllll kira yashigayi yakai three times yana kira banji Auwal ɗin ya amsa ba,daganan yakoma kiran Uztaz da Hafiz suma shiru sekawai nafara kyakyata dariya harda rike ciki. tsayawa yayi yana kallona yana dariyar shima yace "tsaya kiji, Allah zasu amsa" nidai cigaba da dariyata nayi. can yayi saurin tabani yana nunamin saman dutsin yace "kalli can" kallon gurin nayi still banbar dariyar ba and I saw Auwal raising his hands yana nuna alamar yajimu,sekuma gasu Uztaz dasauran suna kokarin karasa hauwara karshen saman dutsin suma suna ɗaga mana hannu.

Lamiɗo yace "babukomai kuyi abunda zakuyi kusauko mutafi" sukace toh kafin suka juyamana baya inda yajuyo yana kallona sannan yace "yanzudai kinyarda sunjini koh?" gyaɗa masakai nayi ina murmushi yace "then I'll patiently wait for my payment zuwa lokacin dakikayi kuɗi" cikeda yarinta nace "nawa zanbaka innayi kuɗin?" shiruuu yayi yana nazari sannan yace "dukyanda kikaga dama"nace "toh zanbaka 3million" dariya sosai yayi yace "Ƴar birni kinsan 3million kuwa?" nace "Ina hundred thousand sau 30 shine 3million" gyaɗa min kai yayi ahankali nace "toh ai innayi kuɗi zanzama inada wannan ammount ɗinkoh?" Ɗayan biscuit ɗin jefamasa nayicikin jaka nace yajedashi gida yaci ainawa muka ci anan. 

Sanda su Auwal suka sauko har biyu tawuce wannan dalilin yasa sukayi sallah a gurguje sukace mujuya gida kawai dan inmunce zamu tafi next location to tabbas dare zaiyi mana ahanya babuko tantama. Tafiya mukayi banawasa ba har wuraren karfe hudu da'yan mintuna bamu isaba gashi dukda hutawan damukeyi ɗin bandaina Jin ciwon kafar danakeyiba barinma fingers ɗin kafana danakejin sun kumbura tacikin canvas ɗin,ƙaran mota mukaji abayanmu wanda hakan yabamu mamaki sosai don hanyar ƙaramar hanyace sosai kuma babu wanda zaitaba tunanin har mota zata iya bita gurin. Drivern yace "Bismillah kushigo toh" zagayawa Lamiɗo yayi yabuɗe kofar gidan gaba yace "Ƴar Birni zoki shiga" zuwa nayi nashiga gaban motan sannan yadubi su Uztaz dasuka saki baki suna kallon ikon Allah yace "Sekunzo toh. mudai munyi gaba" Uztaz cikeda bacin rai yace "haba Lamido mintuna nawama ya rage mu isa bakin kwaltan fisabilillahi? daka bari munkarasa ai kawai" Lamiɗo yace "wannan kuma yaren yan China ne. Kukaɗai kukasanshi" daganan yashige motar yarufe yana faɗin "muje kawai Baba. aishiyasama banyi musu tayiba dan nasansu da iyayi. suje suyita fama susuka sani"

Agarin Babban buli Lamiɗo yacema mai akori kura  yasaukemu inda nina wuce gida shikuma yaje masallaci yayi sallar la'asar sannan yaciro report book ɗin Auwal danashi yashiga copying abubuwan dasukayi a field yau kamar yanda yayi jiya. 

Asanda su Uztaz suka iso harya gama copying yaje ciro kanyar dazaiyi guzurinta suka haɗu a hanya. kokulashi basuyiba sukayi wucewarsu shiko dariya yadingayi ƙasa ƙasa yana faɗin "ku kuka sanidai. baku obeyers ba?kuje kuyitayi" seda yajirasu sukayi sallah sannan suka karbi fura da nonon dasukace a ajiye musu nima naɗebo mishi anagida da aka kawo ɗazu dabananan nakai mishi sannan suka wuce bakin hanya dankomawa masaukinsu.

Toh haka muka cigaba da fita field kullum taredasu harmuka kare wannan satin aka shiga wani. kuma kullum inzan fita sena nema mana abunda zamuci acan nida Lamiɗo hakanan indai akazo inda dole hawan dutsi za'ayi to nidashi samun guri zamuyi muzauna su suhau suyi abunda zasuyi susauko mutafi. kuma kullum dayanma inmuntashi komawa gida Lamiɗo yadinga sawa atsaya a hanya ina hutawa kenan. hakanan duk randa Allah yahaɗamu da mai machine ko akori kura tose Lamiɗo ya tarar mana su yaroƙa mana lift zuwa garin Babban Buli nidashi inda su Uztaz kesamo mu anan suhadu da Lamiɗo suwuce gida. Tun su Uztaz na korafi harsuka daina,Hafiz ma yakoma yashiga binmu danshima cewa yayi yagaji gaskiya,kuma yana ganin bati bazai bariba Allah ya gani. Abubuwan dasuke faruwa a field din kuwa Allah yayi yawa dasu, faɗansu dakuma yanda suke samun sabani a tsakaninsu sukuma dawo su shirya bakaramin dariya yake baniba,gashi Lamiɗo is full of jokes shiyasa innacemuku field work ɗinnan is boring to nayi karya,akwai gajiyakam anma inada mai magance min ita sabida tsaye yake akaina,baya taba bari in wahala. Akwai ranar da mukaje wani quadrant naji Auwal da Uztaz nata emphasising minerals ajjejefe sunyi yawa agurin yakamata su faɗa ma malamansu. da mamaki na natambayi Lamiɗo dake rikeda hannuna nace "meyesa za'a faɗama malamanku minerals sunyi yawa anan gurin?" take yacemin "Wayasan musune Ƴar birni anma bari intambaya maki Auwal" daganan yadubi Auwal yace "Auwal Ƴar birni na tambaya. wai miyesa zaku faɗa ma samudawan malamankucan minerals sunyi yawa anan" Auwal yayi dariya yace "malaman namune samudawan Lamiɗo?" Lamiɗo yace "Yoh ba samudawan bane? mutanen da basu da aiki secin teba da doya inba'a haɗa su da samudawa ba dame za'a haɗasu fisabillahi?" Hafiz dake dariya yace "Ga Mr ogwechuku abayanka" aidasauri Lamiɗo yajuya a rikice dariya suka saki dukansu Auwal nafaɗin "ashema duk iskancinka kana tsoronsu" Lamiɗo dake sauke ajiyar zuciyar danbakaramin razana yayiba,yama manta a field suke babuyanda za'ayi yaga malamansu yace "Sufa zasu bani certificate Auwal. dole inruɗe,wallahi duk iskancina Ina tsoronsu danjahilaine,yanzu sesu hana hanani gama wahalalliyar course ɗinsunnan" sudai su Uztaz inbanda dariya babu abunda sukema Lamiɗo kafin daga karshe Auwal yamin bayi yace duk inda kikaga akwai traces na minerals sosai toh it indicate that somewhere around akwai precious stone shiyasa muka damu mufaɗa ma Malamanmu.

Cikeda gamsuwa nace "kamar sumeyene precious stones ɗin?" Auwal dariya yayi yace "something like diamond,gold dadai sauransu" wara idanu nayi cikeda excitement nace "yanzu kenan zamu iyasamun Gold anan?" Auwal yace "probably, somewhere around dukda ba'asan exact gurinba and it can be something else ba gold ɗinba". yace "kuma ko ansamu location ɗin ma cireshi abune mai wahala Ƴar birni,injinan daza'ayi anfani dasu dakuma yanda za'ayi ba abune mesaukiba mumadakikaji muna maganar kawai don Jin daɗin bakinmune, because munsan komun faɗama baza'a ɗau maganar da mahimmanci ba because we're in Nigeria and here in Nigeria mutanenmu basu ɗaukan valuable magana da mahimmanci. basusan darajar da Allah yamanaba,basusan baiwa da albarkatun kasan da Allah yabamu ba. kawai rashin sanin yanda zamuyi dashine yakedamun mu,rashin sanin ciwon kanmu ke damunmu, selfishness darashin kishin kasarmu ke damun mu dakuma rashin leaders na ƙwarai and above all curruption yamana yawa. Malamin mu bejimannanba yake faɗa mana turawa sunzo suncire gold anan Nigeria,hargurin yakaimu yanuna mana,a Inda suka cire gold din anan sukabar injinan dasukayi amfani dashi tsabar sunsan sunsamu abunda yafi wannan injinan daraja,ninkin baninki. we always say munsamu yancin kanmu but somehow, somewhere still mutanennan suna rulling ɗinmu batareda munsani ba" gyada kaina nayi inajin bayanin Auwal kafin daga karshe yayi dariya yace "but we're hoping for a change Ƴar birni. may be wataran kedakanki kikawomana injin cire gold kiciromana kodan su Gogode susamu" yakarashe maganar playfully.

Dariya kawai nayi inajin daɗin kalamansa. to tell you irin sabon da nayi da mutanen nan adan kwanakin damukayi muna zuwa field tare kalaman baki kaɗai bazasu iya bayyanawaba,barinma Lamiɗo,he has become part of me,shidin wani mutum ne dana ajiye masa gurbi nadaban cikin zuciyata dukda kuwa kankancin shekaruna,he makes my holiday a kauyen Babban buli so special and memorable than the others,he always makes sure that I'm okay danko a field wani irin extra care yakebani fiye da sauran,danko ran su zai baci indai yasan zan wahala tobazai bari ni incutuba. acewarsa I'm his responsibility throughout the field,so he's keeping his promise kamar yanda yafaɗa masu tun ranar da suka fara tafiya dani. Akwai ranan da ran Auwal yabaci akan delay ɗinda Lamiɗo yakeja musu kuma duk yawanci akaina ne shiyasa yakasa hakuri dan yakaishi bango ranar yace "wainikam Lamiɗo field work mukazoyi ko ɗiban ya'yan mutane muje muna renonsu a field?" ran Lamiɗo bakaramin ɓaci yayiba dan dukda indirectly Auwal yayi maganar kowa yasan dani yakeyi kuma har cikin raina banji daɗin maganar ba,it makes me feel like i'm a burden to them. Lamiɗo kasa ɓoye bacin ransa yayi yacema Auwal "dukwanda kaga yamaka aciki kasaka shi aranka and mind your tongue. cikinku babu wanda akasaka dole akace yayi renon Ƴar birni kamar yanda kake iƙirari and I see nothing dakukeyi mata tunda mukazo,inkuma danjira dakukeyi ta hutane dakuma yanda akemayardaku baya dankun hau hills kundawo ta'inda kuka hau toh kasani niban taɓa cewa kujiraniba, I've never asked for this favor,infact tunma kafin muhadu da'ita,tun a field work ɗinmu na aji biyu kowa yasan kullum cewa nake kowa yayi takanshi,bance dole se anjiraniba. So stop blaming an innocent soul Please. Inzakayi faɗan ka kayi dani" kankace mi sun fara exchanging words a junansu harma kamar zasuyi dambe,dakyar Uztaz yaraba faɗan yabasu hakuri dukansu sannan aka cigaba da aiki.....
***
Ranar juma'a da yanma lilis sukagama mapping inda aka sasu suyi gaba ɗaya,meaning sungama field work ɗinsu kenan na aji uku saura komawa makaranta acigaba da fafatawa da sauran courses. inajinsu sunata murnar gobe bazasu fitoba ranar hutu ce,masuyin wanki suyi wankinsu,masu shirya kayansu sushirya inda jibi lahadi dasassafe zasu kama hanyar Gombe.  Nidai jinayi gaba ɗaya jikina yayi sanyi,naji komai bayamin daɗi,naji nakasa walwala gaba ɗaya hakanan bana tayasu murnar tafiyar tasu,haka suka dinga hiran yanda komawartasu zata kasance,daga mecewa zaikira mamarsa yafaɗa mata abunda zata girkamai se Kabir dake cewa dayakoma aranar zaije gidan kwallo kallon football inda sauran sukayi caaa akansa sunacewa "sumai zaikaisu zuwa kallon kwallo" Uztaz yace "ai in faɗa muku ni inkuka ganni cikin makaranta asatin dazai gabatannan toh ku tabbata dolece ta kawoni dan wallahi sena sauƙe duka gajiyan da'aka taramin nasamu isasshen bacci kafin nafara shigowa school" Hafiz yace "Uztaz kanama magana anaji,koni daba ɗan Gombe ba a hostel nikezama babu abunda zaisani zuwa lectures,sebayan sati guda" Auwal yace "hutun jaki da kaya aka zakuyi kenan?" Hafiz yace "basai kayi comment ba Auwalllll kaidaman kowa yasan ko malamanne sukace ahuta bahutawan zakayiba,sekashigo kayi bokonka na jarabar nan" Lamiɗo da Faith kuwa basusaka baki a hirar tasuba dan ita tana making phone call inda mukuma muke biyedasu abaya,Lamiɗo na riƙe da hannuna yana swinging playfully harmuka isa garin Babban buli. agaban masallaci suka ajiye jakakkunansu suka nufi rijiya daniyar ɗiban ruwa anma koda wasa Lamiɗo yaƙi sakin hannuna nima kuma sena kasa cewa yasaki ɗin kamar yanda nasaba kullum inmuka dawo daga field. munfi mintuna uku atsaye shibaije yayi alwalan ba shikuma baice zaiyi copying abubuwan dasukayi a field kamar yanda yasaba kullum ba. Faith dake zaune jikin wata bishiyane takwala kiran sunansa tace "Lamiɗo harkayi sallan ne kai?" cemata yayi 'A'a" tace "Aiko dakaje kayi. time is going kar azo ana jiranmu"  memakon yabata amsa seya dubeni yayi murmushi yace "Muje inraka ki gida for the first and last time Ƴar birni" daganan yaja hannuna mukabar gurin anma da mamakina damuka Isa kofar gida memakon yabarni Inshiga gidan seyajani mukayi can bayan gidanmu dayake babu mutane sosai a arean se gonaki da lambuna. Jikin wata bishiya muka tsaya yanuna min wata yarkaramar dutsi yace "Zauna toh" zama nayi kamar yanda yace inyi sannan shima ya tsuguna agabana yana kallona yace "meyafaru naji bakya magana tun ɗazu? kinyi shiru kamar wata marar lafiya" nanda nan idanuna suka kawo kwalla kamar dama jira suke,Lamiɗo yarude yace "Kuka nace kiyi Ƴar Birni? daga tambaya seki fara zubda hawayenki? did i say anything wrong?" jijjigamasa kai nayi ahankali alamar a'a sannan cikin kuka nace "bakaine zaka tafi kabarni ba" dukda halin dayake ciki he couldn't stop himself from laughing yace "Daman tare mukazo? dazakice zantafi inbarki?" Yace "Naga takaina ni Lamido,wani inyaji maganar nan seya ɗauka satoki nayi daga wani gu nakawo ki daji zanyi dumping ɗinki bayan nima anan naganki,nayi sabo dake harnakejinki araina kamar yanda nakejin su Jidda dukdama kekince bakison Yaya kamanni sabida ni makaryacine" nashiga goge kwalla na inatura baki gaba nace "nibance ba" yayi dariya yace "kindainamin kallon makaryacin kenan?" Cikin sauri nace "Eh" Lamiɗo yace "Toh nagode Ƴar birni kuma tunda kinyi accepting dina amatsayin yayanki inason kisani cewa babu Yayan dazai taɓa tafiya yabar kanwarsa without finding a way dazasuna communicating. shiyasa nakirawo kinan don muyi sallama,musamu yanda zamu dingagaisawa da juna" wani irin daɗi ne yakamani jinkalaman Lamiɗo yace "Toh yanzu dai yaushe zakigama hutu kikoma gida?" nace "hutuna saura kwana goma sha ɗaya" shiru yayi nawasu daƙiƙu alamun yana tunani sannan yace "Kuma su Baffa basuda waya?" gyaɗa masa kai nayi ahankali,yace "babu wanda kikasani yanada waya agarinnan?" nanma gyaɗa masa kai nayi alamar "eh" yace "anma ai Baba yanada ita koh?" nace "Eh yanadashi" yace "toh kin riƙe number tasane?" tura bakigaba nayi nace "banrikeba" sa hannu yayi yaja siririn karan hancina playfully yace "Kai Ƴar birni duk iya tambayarki baki taɓa tambayar Baba yabaki number wayarsa ba?" nace "Ai duk inda nake zuwa hutu basuda waya shiyasa bana tambayarsa. Gidansu Kawu Sani ne kawai sukeda waya kuma duksunada lambartasa acikin wayoyinsu"  Lamiɗo yace "yaka mata dai  kiriƙe because the need might arise one day" nace "toh shikenan innakoma gida zan ce Baba yabani number tasa in haddace" Lamiɗo yace "Good. toh anma niyanzu yaza'ayi dani Ƴar birni? zankoma garinmu banida hanyar dazan rinƙa communicating dake bare har Inhaɗa ki da su Umma da Aunty jidda. Ga uwa uba 3million danake binki,bashin da bansan ranar daza'a biyaniba" yakarashe cikin sigar zolaya.

Pouting bakina nayi sannan nace "Ina kaƙi kiramin su Aunty jiddan ma mugaisa dasu. Tunyaushe nikebinka" nakarashe maganar Ina batarai yayi dariya kafin yasa hannuwanshi yakama kunnuwansa cikin sigar lallashi yace "I'm sorry Ƴar birni. keɗince bakida sa'a tun ranar da Umma taƙira agabanki basu sake ƙira inmuna tareba nikuma banida recharge card ɗin kiransu bare kugaisa,six thousand Umma tabani dazamu taho garinnan,nabada 5k kuɗin contribution ɗin abincin da ake girka mana gaba ɗayanmu,1k ɗinkuma tuni nayi bidirina dasu wallahi ɗari biyu kawai yaragemin shima dan nabada arontane da tuni nakashe shi. kuma daman in andawomin dashi plan ɗina in sayama su Jidda tsaraba a hanya. Ƴar birni dayanzu haka yana hannuna babu abunda zaihana ni zuwa insiyo katin insaka awayata kugaisa dasu Umma. Kuɗin na hannun wanda inajin kunyar tambayarsa dan inabinsa bashi. I'm very sorry kinji?" Yakarashe maganar muryarsa na nuna how really sorry he's.

Lokaci ɗaya nasaki fuskata jin kalamansa sannan yace "anma barina baki numberna as soon as kinkoma gida kibama Baba number yaƙira miki ni nikuma namiki alkawarin haɗaki dasu kugaisa,in Umma tabarima Insha Allah zankawo miki su Jidda a hutu hargida kugaisa,Bauchi da gombe aibawani nisa sosai zumunci bazai gagaraba. I know how it feels to stay alone without siblings,tsakanina da Basma akwai rata seda nayi wayau sosai sannan akahaifeta and I was very lonely even though inada uwa inada uba alokacin untill she was born barekuma ke da abun ya hade miki harda rashin mahaifiya. I can feel your pain Nanah(the first time he calls this name. sunan da babu wanda nakejin ya'iya fadansa dakyau kamarshi) yakarashe maganar ahankali sannan yasaka hannu cikin aljihunsa yaciro paper da biro yarubuta min number sa yaninke papern kafin yakamo hannuna yasaka aciki yadunkule hannunnawa yanafadin "Keep it save please" atake kuma wayarsa tashiga ringing dubawa yayi *Auwal* ne ke kira cikeda damuwa yace "lord! Auwal ke kirana. Nanah I've to go(the second time he calls the name) gashi ko sallan ma banyiba" yakarashe maganar ayayinda yatashi daga tsugunen dayake nikuwa dukda dadin da sabon sunan dayasaukamin yamin behanani tambayarsaba nace "Nanah kuma? sunana fah Rukayya koka manta?" wannan karan cheeks ɗina yaja yana murmushi sannan yace "nasan kinsan duk masu suna Rukayya ana iyacemusu Nana anma kike tambayana tsabar curiosity dinki yamiki yawa,you always want to have a genuine reason kafin kiyi concluding abu" natura bakigaba nace "toh ai babu wanda yataba kirana da Nanah agida shiyasa natambaya" Lamiɗo yace "Toni daga yau sunan dazan na kiranki dashi kenan inkuma kinason su Jidda sunacemiki Yar birni ne toh shikenan se in faɗamusu sunanki Ƴar birni" cikin sauri nace "Banaso" yayi dariya sannan wanda alokacin wayarshi tasake fara ruri,maida wayar yayicikin aljihunsa sannan yafara jogging yana waiwayena yace "Bye bye Ƴar birni. Don't forget to call me as soon as you get home kinji?" gyaɗa masa kai nayi alokacin ina ɗaga hannu inamasa byebye harya kulemin dagani.

Najima zaune gurin kafin nakoma gida hannuna dunkule da papern daya rubuta min phone number ɗinsa,Koda na minti ɗaya nakasa sassauta rikon danama papern,gani nakeyi kamar inna sassauta rikon papern zaifadi,shikenan kuma narabu da Lamiɗo har abada kenan dankuwa nasan awannan lokacin wannan paperne kaɗai linkage ɗina dashi. Agida nasamu labarin sunyima Baffanaina sallama kuma har gida sukazo sukama Gogode sallama suna tambayar inda nake Gogode tacemusu banshigo gidaba kafin suka tafi bayan Lamido yayi appearing. araina nace "Allah sarki kozan sake haɗuwa dasu arayuwa?"

( _The story of Rukayya_ )

Written by *Zeeneert*💞

*Zeeneert*@wattpad

*Page Ten*

Free Page

***
Yau lahadi kuma yau kwana biyu rabona da ganinsu Lamiɗo,kuma innace banyi kewan suba nayi ƙarya,dukda nakoma normal activities ɗina like before anma harcikin raina Ina missing ɗinsu. Gashidai ko sati biyu banyi taredasu ba anma gaba ɗaya little memories ɗinda mukayi making tareda su yakasa daina lingering a kwakwalwarta, suɗin wasu mutane ne dasuka shigo cikin rayuwata cikin lokaci ƙanƙani suka gama samun gurbi acikin zuciyata. ko mutanen da muka tashi gida ɗaya,mukayi wayau tare nakekuma ganinsu akai akai basu shiga raina kamar yanda yan click ɗin su Lamiɗo suka shiga raina. To talk about how I'm missing Lamiɗo is unexpressable,acikin kwana biyunnan sautari dayawa inzan ƙira sunan Gogede ko Indo se ince "Yaya lamido kaza, yaya Lamiɗo kaza" tun Gogede naganin abun kamar wasane hartazo tafara kwabata tana faɗan miyasa nake yawan ambaton sunanshi bayan bayanan. miyasa suda suke zaune dani shekara da shekaru kuma inazuwa hutu gunsu akai akai sunansu baizauna akaina kamar yanda sunan Lamiɗo yazauna abakina ba....

Nidai shiru kawai nakeyi hartagama babatunta tagama. danni kaina bansan daliliba,even though I was small back then,I used to feel so secured with him. Abu ɗaya na lura yana damun Gogede,damuwarta bewuce akan abunda mutane zasuceba, she's always afraid of the society,she's always afraid of how they'll judge us as her grandchildren dukda kuwa kauyen Babban buli bawani kauyen azo agani bane dahar mutum zaidaga hankalinshi akan silly things haka shiyasa take yawan kwabarmu damunyi mistake kaɗan, gani take Inna yawaita kiran sunan Lamiɗo har wasu sukaji a ƙauyen zasuyi judging ɗinshi into something else.

Adaren ranar naji Gogode nama Indo magana kan taciro mata ɗaya daga cikin kayanta dake cikin akwatinta na ƙarfe dakecan saman sif gobe da sassafe zataje gari,Jin haka yasa cikin sauri nataso daga kwancen danake nadubeta cikeda zumuɗi nace "Gogode mi doftai ma (Gogode zanbiki)" take Gogode tace "A'a babu inda zaki kiyizaman ki agida. nima bajimawa zanyiba" sekawai nabare baki nafara kukan shagwaba ina faɗin nisaina bita,cikeda damuwa Gogode tajanyoni zuwa jikinta tafara lallashina tareda alƙawarin zata kawomin tsaraba inzata dawo in faɗi komi nakeso anma maganar binta kam inyi hakuri inda zataje ba'a zuwa da yara

Banbar kukaba harlokacin na tura baki gaba sannan nace "nibanason tsaraba Gogode. gurin Baba daman nikeson kikaini inzaki tafi dani" cikin sigar lallashi Gogode tace "keda kika zo hutu kuma mezakijeyi gurin Babanki hutunnanki be ƙare ba. Kokin gaji damune Ru'eyya?" Gogode takarashe maganar ahankali. 
Cikin sauri na girgiza kaina alamar "A'a" sannan nace "bangaji dakuba Gogode kawai naji inakewansa ne kwana biyunnan kuma ko ada danakezuwa hutu in anyi kwana biyu yakanzo yadubaku harnima insamu inganshi inji dadi araina anma yanzu rabonshi da garinnan yafi sati biyu bezoba shiyasa nadamu inje inganshi. Wayasanima ko rashin lafiyarsa ce tatashi" nakarashe maganar idanuna nasake tara kwallah hakanan muryata nanuna tsananin tsoro da fargaban danashiga danayi tunanin he might be sick shiyasa baizo ba.

Cikin sauri najanye jikina daga jikin Gogode Ina kallonta nace "ko bayida lafiya ne Gogode? Baffa Idiii yajemasa ziyara kwanannnan ne?" Gogode daduk taruɗa tace "wayacemiki bayida lafiya? ko fatan yayi rashin lafiyankike yimasa?" Cikin sauri nace "bafata nikeyi masaba. yana yawan rashin lafiyane shiyasa natambaya" Gogode tace "toh lafiyarsa Lau wancan satinma Baffanki yajegurinsa" goge kwallarda nakasa hanasu zubowa nayi cikin sauri inasauke wani irin ajiyar zuciya Jin abunda Gogode tace sannan cikin karyayyar muryar irin wanda anmaka doledinnan,babu yanda ka'iya nace "toh shikenan tunda lafiyarshi Lau zanbari se hutuna yaƙare inkoma gida gaba ɗaya anma don Allah Gogode kifaɗa ma Baffa yanayawan zuwa gida yana dubashi dan jikin nashi se ahankali" Gogode jana tayi cikin jikinta ta rungume tana shafa gadon bayana batareda ta'iya cewa komaiba wanda inada tabbacin na tausayina ne dakuma nadamar karyar datayimin. Washegari dasafe tatafi cikin garin Bauchi tadawo bayan azahar wanda alokacin ni bana gida inacan gidansu Hansai Innarta nayimin kitso jiya nayi tsifa da dare.

Yanma lilis nadawo shima inashiga ɗaki nacire kayana nadaura zani nashige bayi donyin wanka. bayan nashirya maghriba tayi danhaka nayi sallah sannan mukazauna cin abinci da Indo inda daganan kuma muka tafi dandali wasa. 
***
Bayan fitarmu Baffa yashigo gida sabida kiran da Gogode tayimai,agefen taburman datake zaune cikin rumfar kofar ɗakinta yazauna yana gaidata. Gogode ta'amsa inda yashiga tambayarta yanayin jikin Baba.

Sekawai tafara kuka,atake jikin Baffa yayi sanyi cikeda damuwa yace "Gogode kukan namenene kuma? Jikinnashi yayi tsanani ne komi?" cikin kuka Gogode tace "Umar najin jiki Idii,abun se addu'a kawai" jiki sanyaye Baffa yace "ikon Allah kuma shekaran jiya wancan danajeni jikin nashi dasauki sosai dan azaunema nasameshi harmukayita hira dashi yana tambayana Ru'eyya. Ashe bayan dawowana jikin yasake tashi?" gyaɗa kai Gogode tayi tana matsar kwallah sannan tace "mutumin da sai andaga ankwantar yanzu,komai yimashi akeyifah" Baffa Idiii yace "Ikon Allah. Toh Allah yatashi kafaɗunsa" Gogode tace "Amin ya Allah Idii. daman nakirakane batun Rukayya,inaganin zancen boye boyennan ya'isa hakanan,abunda yasa mukayi shiru ada ɗinma sabida munyi tunanin ciwon dazai warke yau ko gobene anma abuyakai ga har mutum baya iya tashi dakanshi se an daga ankwantar inaganin bekamata mucigaba da boyema yarinyarnan batun rashin lafiyar mahaifintaba gaskiya" Baffa yajinjina kai yanajin bayanan Gogode hartakai karshe sannan yace "kinada gaskiya Gogode anma batun alkawarin dana ɗaukar ma Umar fah? yanzu inyaga an ɗauki Yarsa ankaimasa bayan yace bayason tasani bazaiyi tunanin na kasa riƙe alkawarin dana ɗaukar mai ba? Bakya ganin zaiyi tunanin nakasa bama Yarsa farin cikin dayakeso asanda yake kwance kan gadon asibiti?" Gogode tace "nibansan wannan ba bankuma ɗaukeshi da mahimmanci kamar yanda nafi damuwa da Ƴar nan taje taga mahaifinta shima yaganta,koba komai intana taredashi shikanshi zaifijin dadi hakanan addu'an Yara karbabbiyace Insha Allah. Hali ne narayuwa Idiii babu wanda yasan abunda gobe zata haifar shiyasa kaga nayi wannan maganar" Baffa Idiii yadan numfasa sannan yace "duk shawarar dakika yanke yayi Gogode,inkince akaitan se akaitan mudai fatanmu Allah yabashi lafiya" Gogode tace "Amin ya Allah. Koni banason tashin hankalin Ru'eyya anma yazanyi? wayasan ranar daza'a sallameshi? Kuma dolefa tasani tunda hutunsu ma yakusa karewa sannan abumai mahimmanci ma shine yakamata ace tana tareda shiɗin donkoyau seda Kawunta Sani yatambayeni ita,yakuma nemi ba'asin miyasa ba'a kawota ba shine nasanar dashi abunda kacemin.
atake yacemin "wannan ba ƙwaƙwaran dalili baneba,Umar na'iya cewa kar akai Rukayya sabida kartaga yanayin jikinsa hankalinta ya tashi anma tabbas intana taredashi shikanshi zefi jin ɗadi" befito yacemin akawotaba anmadai yabani shawara kuma nidai maganarsa tayimin ma'ana fiyeda naka. 

Baffa iddi yace "toshikenan se akaitan kawai" Gogode tace "hakan kam dazaifi. Ko gobe dasafema seka haɗa ta dasu Rahane sukaita taga yanayin jikinnashi daganan ma kaga su Rahanen swa dubashi. Baffa yace "toh Allah yakaimu" kafin yatashi yakoma kofarsu.

Tun a daren ranan bayan nadawo daga dandali Gogode tacemin gobe intashi da sassafe zamuje cikin gari taredasu Yadikko Rahane, daɗi kamar nayi yaya dankuwa tunda tafaɗa min nasama raina indai nashiga garin Bauchi gobe babu abunda zaihana ni zuwa gida ingano Baba kafin mudawo dukda kuwa ɗazu nama Gogode alƙawarin zama se hutuna yaƙare anma ai yanzu ita tace inshirya zamuje gari,kuma indai har zanje gari mezai hanani zuwa gurin Baba? tunda dalili yakaini. Tun adaren naciro kayan dazan saka na ajiyeshi saman akwatin Gogode kafin nakwanta bacci. washegari dawuri natashi nashirya kamar yanda su Yadikko Rahane suka tashi dawuri suma,takwas nayi mukatafi batareda nasan takamaimai inda zamujeba tsabar zumuɗin ance za'aje gari dani,nidai damuwana inje Inga Baba ba inda zasuje bane damuwata. Seda naga taxi driver na ƙoƙarin shiga general hospital na Bauchi sannan nafara tunanin "Daman asibiti zamuje? Toh waye babu lafiya?" and then my heart starts beating without a reason. Sonake intambaya waye babu lafiya anma bakina yayi nauyi,nauyin da nikaina bazan iyacewa ga dalilinsaba.

Ahakadai mai taxi ɗin yasamu guri yayi parking su Yadikko Rahane suka biyashi kuɗinshi sannan muka fara takawa cikin harabar asibitin. Mutane natakai kawo wanda kallo ɗaya zakayima kowannensu kasan ba daɗi yakawosu asibitin ba,jinyace takawosu danwasu zakaga tafiyarma daƙyar sukeyinta,wasu kuma turasu akema akan sickbay,wasu kuma gashidai suna tafiyar lafiya Lau amma kallo ɗaya zakayi musu kagane basuda isasshen lafiya. kawai kwantar dasune ciwon baiyiba,wasu kumada taimakon yan uwansu masu lafiya suke iya takawa. naga mata masu ciki,naga masu ciwon kafa,naga masu zazzabi,naga waɗanda sukayi accident(hatsari) dadai sauransu kuma duk seda suka bani tausayin dan by just a mere look zakagane how much they're suffering dukdama wasu sunfi wasu shan wahala and even though I was very young,deep down in my heart I sympathize with them. It was my first time going to the hospital dannidai bantaba rashin lafiyar datasa aka kwantar daniba,inkaga nayi zazzabi toh baiwuce kwana daya biyuba na warke sekuma mura dayazamo usual ciwona barinma lokacin sanyi,inada pneumonia dukdama baya tashi sosai sabida Baba namatukar ƙoƙari gurin ganin nakiyaye duk abubuwan dazai iyasawa yatashi. 

Tafiya mukadinga yi harmuka isa wani ward,gaida security ɗin gurin Yadikko Deejah tayi sannan tashiga tambayarshi ɗakin da ake ajiye marasa lafiya awannan ward ɗin,kwatance yamana sannan muka mishi godiya muka shige cikin ward ɗin,a kofar dakin daya kwatanta mana muka tsaya. Yadikko Rahane tafara shiga sannan Yadikko Deejah tabi bayanta seni dake biye dasu abaya, ɗakine babba dayakeda tsayi sosai ga kuma gadaje sunfi dayawa,tundaga bakin kofa naga nake ganin duka gadajen ɗakin are all occupied by male patients wanda hakan yasa bugun zuciyana yatsananta batareda nasan dalili ba.

( _The story of Rukayya_ )

A gaban wani gado naga su Yaddiko Rahane sun tsaya wanda hakan yasani tsayawan nima. kallon Kawu Hassan autan mazan gidansu Baba nayi zaune kan wata yar gujera wanda hakan yasani mamakin meyakawo shi asibiti kuma?waye ba Lafiya? sede tunma kafin nasamu damar tambayar wadanda nikejin zasubani amsa yanda yadace naji Yadikko Rahane nafaɗin "Mallam Umaru yajikin?" and if I'm right that's the only name da mutanen Babban buli ke ƙiran mahaifina dashi,afirgice na ƙarasa kusa dasu,nature Yadikko Rahane gefe ina kallon mutumin dake kwance kan sickbay ɗin helplessly. Babana ne,the only Father that everyone could ever ask for,mahaifina abunsona,mahaifina abun alfaharina,mahaifina danake ganin babu kamarshi acikin rayuta. Shine kwance agadon asibiti duk yatsomare,yayi wani iri,kallo ɗaya nayi mashi nasan yana tsananin shan wahala.

Wani irin ihu nasaki ina faɗin "Baba. Baba meyasameka? miyasa suka kawoka gurin marasa lafiya bayan Gogode jiya tacemin lafiyarka Lau? Baba meke damun ka" nayi maganar cikin gunjin kuka ayayinda nafaɗa jikinshi ina jijjiga shi ina faɗin "Baba kayimun magana dan Allah. Baba kacemin dagaske Gogode takeyi lafiyar ka lau"

Anma shiru baicemin komaiba sema jidanayi kamar ina jijjiga gunki wannan dalilin yasa naɗago dakaina cikin sauri nakalleshi. shima kallona yakeyi with so much emotions ayayinda naga hawaye yana zuba daga gefen idanunshi hakanan hannunshi yafara motsi wanda hakan yasani kallon hannayen nashi ina kokarin tabawa Nurses ɗin dake ɗakin sukazo suna ma su Yadikko Rahane magana kan sufitar dani inbazan yi shiruba sabida ina damun sauran patients ɗin dake ɗakin. Yadikko Deejah ne tazo tana ƙoƙarin kama hannuna anma senayi sauri nakama hannun Baba naƙi sakin hannun ina kuka metsuma zuciya. damuwata baiwuce yacemin wani abuba anma kalma ko guda ɗaya yakasa fita daga bakinsa,gashidai bakinshi na motsi alamun he desperately wants to talk anma maganar taki fitowa. ganin Yadikko Deejah takasa rabani da jikin Baba yasa Nurses ɗin dakansu suka zo suka jani daga jikinsa sunamin faɗa da indaina ihu,tayar masa da hankali zanyi dama sauran patients ɗinda ke ɗakin. cikin gunjin kuka nakalli Nurse ɗin nace "Meyesa baya magana? meyasamu Babana don Allah? yaushe zaisamu lafiya mukoma gida? bani da kamarsa, banida maisona irinsa don Allah kubashi maganin dazaisha yasamu sauki mukoma gida. Dan Allah kada kubari Babana ya wahala kamar yanda nake ganin sauran marasa lafiya suna wahala" duka Nurses ukun dasuka fitar dani waje seda suka zubda kwallah tsabar tausayina haka su Yadikko Rahane ma. ganin naƙi yin shiru ne yasa ɗaya daga cikin Nurses ɗin tajani zuwa jikinta ta rungumeni tana faɗin "Ƴan mata ba kuka zakima Baba ba,addu'ar samun sauƙi zakiyi masa kinji?" Ina sheshekar kuka nace "dagaske idan nayi masa addu'a Allah zaikarba yabashi lafiya?" gyaɗa min kai nurse ɗin tayi tana goge kwallarta tace "insha Allah,bareke da kikeda kankantar shekaru ma,Allah yafi karban addu'an yara kanana" jikina na bari nasaki jikinta,butan dana hango kusa da kofar shiga ɗakin nayi sauri naje naɗauka, Allah yataimakeni akwai ruwa aciki. Bantsaya tunanin gurin danake yadace nayi alwala kobai daceba kawai nahauyi agurin inayi ina hawaye,Ina sheshekar kuka....

Suma Nurses ɗin se suka kasa cemin komai,suka kasa hanani dukda kuwa zubda ruwa agurin is out of bound harna idar da alwalan nacire ɗankwalin kaina nasamu gefen da mutane baswa bi nafuskanci gabar nashimfiɗa ɗankwali sannan natada sallah still hawaye basubar bin kuncina ba. Bazan iya faɗa muku mintunan dana ɗauka akowaci sujjadar raka'a biyun danayiba,sallah nake Ina kuka Ina addu'ar Allah yabama Baba lafiya harda shikewa. ganin na galabaita anma still naqi barin sallan har Ina neman faɗuwa sabida irin gajiyar da kafata tayi yasa ina sallamewa tareda niyar tashi insakeyin wata Yadikko Rahane tazo tarungumeni tana faɗin "ya'isa haka Ru'eyya am. zauna kihuta tukunnan" da idanuna dasukayi luhu luhu nadubeta cikin muryar tausayi nace "Baban yasamu lafiya ne?Yatashi ne Yadikko?" kawai se yadikko Rahanen tafara hawayen itama wannan dalilin yasana zame jikina daga nata ina ƙoƙarin tashi ayayinda idanuna ke zubda hawaye nonstop, ƙoƙarin sake riƙoni take amma nakauce ina faɗin "Baba baisamu lafiyaba Yadikko. Kibarni inyi masa addu'a tunda likitancan tace Allah zaikarbi addu'a na inni nayimasa" Yadikko Rahanen seta kasa cemin komai. haka tabarni nacigaba da sallah Ina sheshekar kuka. Bayan azahar Kawu Sani da Yaya Salim sukazo asibitin kuma sanda suka shigo ward ɗin yayi dede da lokacin da karfina yakare, immunity system ɗina yakasa jure tsayuwar danakeyi as a 11 year old child harna yanki jiki nafaɗi nasuma. Yaya Salim ne yafara ganina yana niyar nuna ma Kawu Sani ni nafaɗi na suma wanda hakan yasashi kiran sunana dakarfi "Rukayya!" Ayayinda ya ƙaraso inda nake kwance da gudu. ɗaukana yayi inda akakaini wani ɗaki akasama min bed akafara bani taimakon gaggawa. bantashi sanin inda kaina yakeba se bayan sallar isha'i dana farka naganni kwance kan gadon asibiti,irin gadon da naga Baba akai ɗazu yana kwance helplessly. 

Juyawa nayi ina karewa ɗakin kallo ko Allah zaisa inga Baba anma babushi babu alamarsa,infact nan ɗakine dake ɗaukeda Mata zallah kamar yanda nasu ɗakin ke ɗauke da Maza zallah. tunanin halin da Baba yakeciki dakuma inda yake yasani saurin tashi zaune Ina ƙoƙarin sauka akan gadon Gogode tayi saurin zuwa tamayar dani ta kwantar tana faɗin "Ina zakije kuma?" hawaye nafarayi sannan nace "zanje gurin Baba ne incigaba dayimasa addu'a. koya samu lafiya ne?" Naqarashe maganar cikeda hope Ina kallon Gogode anma hawayen dana gani idanunta irinna Yadikko Rahane yasa gwiwata tasage,nasake fara kokarin sauka daga kan gadon ina faɗin "Gogode kikaini gurin Baba,Gogode kikaini inyi masa addu'a, Gogode kikaini gurinsa inzauna kusa dashi don Allah" hakuri tadinga bani anma naqi sararawa hardai Kawu Sani da Yaya Salim suka shigo ɗakin.

Ina ganinsu suma nafara rokonsu Ina kuka nace "Yaya Salim Ina Baba?don Allah kakaini gurin Baba" namatsa daga jikin Gogode nakarasa bakin gadon ina kuka nariƙo hannun Yaya Salim ina kuka tareda marairaice murya nace "kana yiwa Baba addu'a kaima?" seyakasa amsamin yajani zuwa jikinshi yakwantar dani akan kafaɗunshi yana comforting ɗina yace "it's okay Rukayya. Stop crying pleaseee" amma senaki daina kukan,nadago Ina kallon Kawu Sani kamar wata tababbiya nace "Kawu Sani Yaya Salim ma yarone ko? Kuma inyama Baba addu'a Allah zaikarbakoh?" Kawu Sani yace "insha Allah nakowa ma Allah zaikarba Rukayya" folding hannuna nayi alamar roko Ina kallonshi nace "tokuma kuna saka shi a addu'a don Allah. kawu karoki su Yaya Salim su Yaya Rabi'u, Yaya Fahad,su Yaya Zaheera dasu Yaya kaltum duk suna sashi a addu'a kilan yasamu sauki anjima ko gobe"

Gyaɗa kai Kawu Sani yayi yana shafa kaina yace "it's okay zan faɗa musu. Just stop crying kinji?" sa hannuna nayi nashiga share hawayena dukda kuwa haryanzu wasu suna bin wasu nace "nadaina. Sallahma zanje incigaba dayi inyi masa addu'a" nakarashe magana Ina kokarin sake tashi daga kan gadon.

Cikin sauri Yaya Salim yariƙo ni yamayar dani yazaunar tareda sake kwantar dani jikinsa,Kawu Sani zama yayi gefena yakama hannuna yana min massage ahankali ayayinda Yaya Salim yafara magana yace
"Allah zai karbi addu'an ki insha Allahu Rukayya,kuma badole se a tsaye ake addu'a ba ko akwance mutum zaiyi kuma insha Allahu Allah zaikarba indai da tsarkakkar niya akayishi,baki ganin condition ɗinki ne? you're very sick sabida irin tsayuwar dakikayi yau. towai inkika fara rashin lafiya irinna Uncle Umar tayaya zakiyi masa addu'ar? koshi Uncle ɗin an faɗa miki zaiji daɗi inyaji kinfara ciwo sabida shi? get hold of yourself my Dearest Sis,pray for him yanda yakamata. Stressing yourself isn't a solution. you're just making the matter even worst than before. Rukayya you've to take very good care of yourself if not for your self then for Uncle Umar kinajina?" Jijjiga masakai nayi ahankali still ina hawaye sannan nace "toh ina Baba Yaya Salim? kukaini gurinshi" wannan karan Kawu Sani ne yace "liedown first,kwanta kihuta Rukayya. za'akaiki daga baya kiganshi" Ina hawaye nace "Toh yaushe zaka kaini gunshi Kawu Sani?" Kawu Sani yace "inkika kwantar da hankalinki kika samu lafiya dawuri aka sallameki" lumshe idanuna nayi hawaye nazuba kamar famfo hakanan duk addu'ar datazo bakina yinakeyi, inayi inahadawa da "Ya Allah kabama Baba lafiya,ya Allah kaji tausayina banida kamarsa" har nannauyar bacci yayi awun gaba dani.

Washegari darana akayi discharging ɗina kuma babu wanda ya ziyarceni a dangin mahaifina face *Kawu Sani* da 
*Yaya Salim* anma ni duk wannan baidameni ba sabida basune agabana ba wannan lokacin. Wani guri daban da inda naga Baba jiya su kawu Sani suka kaini naga Baba kuma ɗakin na single patient ne(VIP) bakamar wancan da8kin dake daukeda marasa lafiya sunfi talatinba. ɗakine mekyau harda Ac,Tv,fridge dadai sauran kayan bukatu dasuka zamana necessary ayi amfani dasu a day to day life activities ɗinmu. yanzuma Baba baiyimin magana ba kuma still Kawu Hassan ke jinyarsa danshi kaɗai mukasamu a ɗakin,karasawa nayi gaban gadon nazauna ina kallonshi hawaye nabin kuncina,motsin hannunshi danaji akusa da cinyoyina ne yasani kallon hannun nashi,Ina kuka nasa hannu nakamo nashi hannun nasaka cikin nasa ina faɗin "Sannu Baba" damamakina Sena ga ya lumshe min idanu ayayinda ya matse hannuna cikin nashi. wani irin feeling naji,the feeling of belongingness, feeling irin wanda ke kara tabbatarmin cewa Yes. This's my Father and he's the most lovable and the important person in my life.

Gogode ma zuwa tayi tamasa yajiki inda yalumshe mata idanu tareda sakin murmushin karfin hali kamar yanda yamin. Gogede tace "Allah yabaka lafiya Umaru, Allah yasa garkuwan jikine" duka Ƴan ɗakin suka amsa da Amin daganan kuma yarufe idanu wani nannsuyar bacci yayi awun gaba dashi. Kawu Sani dake tsaye harlokacin yadubi Kawu Hassan yace "Adamu da Yaya idriss sunzo da safennan ne?" Kawu Hassan yace "Eh sunzo basujima ba suka wuce kasuwa shago" Kawu Sani da mamaki yace "basumaka maganar test ɗinda akace ayiba?" Kawu Hassan yajijiga kai alamar a'a sannan yace "basuyimin ba gaskiya. Yaya idrissa dai yakawo magungunan da likitan yarubuta shekaranjiya" Kawu Sani yace "yau yakawo maganin?" gyaɗa kai kawu Hassan yayi. cikeda mamaki Kawu Sani yace "Kuma kace tun shekaranjiya aka rubuta drugs ɗin?" nanma Kawu Hassan yagyada kai alamar "eh".

Daganan Kawu Sani besake cewa komai game dasuba sema tambayar cards ɗinda likitocin suka bama Kawu Hassan dayayi. nan Kawu Hassan yaɗauko duka yabashi,atake Kawu Sani yashiga dubawa yaɗauki wanda zai ɗauka ya mayarmai da sauran yace "this card has been with you guys for almost a week now but no body cares to do what was instructed in the card" Hassan dabai gane me kawu Sani ke faɗa ba anmadai yasan faɗa akan cards ɗin yakeyi kuma bazai wuce narashin siyo maganin dawuri bane yasashi cewa "Yaya ni likitan na bani takardunnan na danka ma Yaya idrissa tun adaren ranar daganan shima baice komai ba,nasandai kullum in likitoci sunzo sukan tambayi sakamakon gwaji kuma insunzo nakan sanardasu baswa cewa komai. Shekaran jiya da likitan yazo yaga jikin Yaya Umar ɗin yayi tsanani shine yarubuta magungunar nan yace asaya na ulcer da typhoid ɗinda suka tabbatar yana dashi ne kwanaki kafin musamu muyi test ɗinda sukace ayi dan tabattar da ɗayan cutar da ake tunanin yana dashi. Kuma su Yaya idrissa nazuwa naɗauki katin nabasu wanda seyau dasafen nan suka kawo maganin" tsaki Kawu Sani yayi sannan yafice a ɗakin inda Yaya Salim yabishi abaya.

Faɗa Kawu Sani yadingayi bayan fitarsu da Yaya Salim yace "people are so heartless wallahi. Ɗan uwanka ma bazaka tsaya kabashi time ɗinda yakamataba adede lokacin daya fi bukatarka for goodness sake? Everyone is just so selfish. People nowadays value money more than relationships. Bana gari Umar yafara rashin lafiyarnan Salim,I was in Lagos idriss yaƙirani yake faɗamin anyi admitting ɗinsa a asibiti. Atake nace masa acikinsu wani yazauna dashi,koshi ko Adamu kafin indawo kokuma anemi wani babba daga Giyaɗe yazo inma su bazasu zauna ba dan banma yi maganar kuba sabida nasan abunda Babba zai iya ba lallai ku ku iya ba but to my very own surprise jiya ina dawowa da mukazo na tadda Hassan ne zaune gunshi,shiyake jinyar Umar fisabilillahi. me Hassan yasani banda kwaba? bagwanda kubama akanshi dukda yagirmeku amma ai kukunfishi wayewa. tundaga expression ɗin likitan dakuma yanda yake mayar min da magana jiya bayan naje amayar dashi side room(VIP) nagane something is fishy,I asked about the health and his answer was anbamu test muje muyi munkiyi fiyeda sati me mukeso yayi mana?

Hakuri nabashi kancewa za'ayi ajiyan insha Allahu. fitowana daga gunsa nasamoka adakin da aka kwantar da Rukayya daniyar innasake dubata zankoma can ɗakin inkarbi card ɗin test ɗin inkai lab suzo suɗauki sample suyi Auntyn ku takirani wai *IYA* taƙi tasha drugs ɗin ta kuma kafafunta nadamunta shine natafi gida bayan naƙira Adam nafaɗa masa dalilaina nace atake yazo yaje yakai lab ɗin but it turns out baizoba tunda gashi haryazo dasafennan ma benemi sanin ko anyi test ɗin ko ba'ayi ba. haka yaɗibi kafafunsa yatafi wurin aiki,nikuma banyi tunanin tura kaba alokacin kwata kwata sabida naga kuna tareda Rukayya babu daɗi abarta ita kaɗai kafin Gogoden ta ta'iso"

Harsuka Isa lab ɗin asibitin Kawu sani faɗa yakeyi sosai kan rashin nuna kulawar dasu Kawu Adamu kema Baba dagasu har iyalinsu.

Kawu Sani yace "I'm very disappointed by them wallahi. dan bantama tsanmanin zasuyi abukamar hakaba even though najima dasanin cewa Adamu da Yaya idrissa kansu kaɗai suka sani,Yan ɗakin su kaɗai suka damuda sabida irin hudubar kajin da mahaifiyar su tayimusu anma ai yanzu shekaru sunja. Kowa yayi hankali kuma cikinmu babu ƙaramin yaro bare ace yana following footsteps ɗin tane.
Inbanda abunsu ma surasa wazasu ma wannan rashin kulawar se Umar? Umar ɗinda baidamu dakansa kamar yanda yadamu damuba? Umar ɗinda komai nashi nakowane? Umar ɗinda damuwar kowa nasane? Umar ɗinda ke kokarin kyautatawa kowa even though bawani karfi gareshi ba zuciyar yine kawai Allah yabashi donkomu damuka fishi samu bamukaishi yin alheri ba,bamu kaishi taimakon marasa karfin cikin dangiba dakuma kyautata ma iyaye. Nannan sanda Adamu yayi rashin lafiya rai a hannun Allah ina Umar ɗin ne yazauna dashi na tsawon watanni uku a asibiti batareda ya gajiya ba anma duk sun manta wannan,sonkai da son abun duniya ya rufe musu idanu" Salim yace "Abba abunfa se du'a'i kawai. wani sa'in iyayen mu mata ke causing rarrabuwar kannan tsakanin Ƴaƴa,they always cause confusion,they always involve their children cikin faɗan su da kishinsu" Kawu Sani yace "that's the point my Son. kowa sotake Ɗanta ya bi bayanta,kowa sotake Ɗanta yashigar mata faɗa wanda inkuma hakan yafaru se afara samun sabani sabida babu Ɗan da zaiso araina uwarsa yayi shiru batareda yashigar mataba. Daganan kuma andinga samun rarrabuwar kai kenan. Women are just so hard to understand really" Salim yace "hakane but ni aganina Abba no matter how the differences between our mothers bekamata ace ana samun rabuwar kai tsakanin Ƴaƴa ba sabida sufa iyayen nan namu da wasunmu keson shige musu faɗan basanin juna sukayiba,zaman aurene yahaɗasu ayayinda sukuma ƴaƴan jini yariga ya haɗa, they're bearing thesame Father and identity. Then why always the fight?" dafa kafaɗunshi Abba yayi yace "da ace kowani Ɗa zaiyi tunani irin naka da polygamy house da dama sun rabu da irin matsalolinnan da Ƴaƴansu ke fama dashi. I just hope my other children think the way you do Son" murmushi Salim yayi batareda yace komaiba.

Haka suka karbo robar da za'a dibi jinin Baba suka kaima Nurse on duty yazo yaɗiba sannan akamayar lab ɗin don carrying test ɗin inda akace daga baya aje akarbi report. A makeken shagonsu dake makare da atamfofi,laces,shaddodi kala kala,kayan yara da manya dadai sauransu yasamesu. gakuma customers daketa kai kawo cikin shagon suna sayan kaya. Kawu Sani bayan sungaisa dasauran yaran shagon yaceda Yaya idrissa yanason magana dasu shida Kawu Adamu wanda hakan yasasu shigewa can cikin store room ɗinsu suka kebe.

Magana yayi musu akan abunda sukayi anma memakon sununa regret ɗinsu sesuka daura ma Kawu Hassan laifi suka ce su bece musu komaiba,basu saniba.

Kawu idrissa dayake ganin Kawu Sanin raini yakeson yimai ba gyaraba yace "ya'isheka Sani,ya'isa haka. karka faɗa mana maganar banza. duk zuwan damukeyi muna dubashi baka ganiba,duk bata kuɗin transport da kuɗin mai ɗinda akayi akan iyalanmu dasukaje dubashi baka ganiba?sayan maganin danayi yauda safe nakawo shima duk baka ganiba se little mistakes ɗinmu koh? toh kai meya hanaka zuwa dakaga kafi kowa sonshi? yanda kakeson aikin ka haka mukeson namu muma hakanan yanda kakeson ciyarda iyalinka dede gwargwado haka muma mukeso muyi shiyasa muke faɗi tashi" cikeda bacin rai Kawu Sani yace "miye amfanin zuwanku dana iyalan naku tunda ba abunda yadace kukeyi ba? Kuma a shagon naku mekukeyi inbanda zama? ba yaranku ke aikin ba?" wannan Karan Kawu Adamu ne yayi magana yace "Dan yaranmu ke aiki se akace bazamuyi supervision ba?" Kawu Sani yace "gaskiya ce dai guda ɗaya kuma bakwa sonta sannan inason kusani rayuwarnan bakomai bane acikinta,inmutum yace zasa hassada da kyashi aransa toh he'll never succeed. Kuma in mutum yayi mai kyau zai gani a kwaryar sa,inbakayi maikyau dinbama duka mutum zai gani a kwaryarsa" daganan yajuya yafita rai bace yana mamakinsu. 
Atunaninshi dukda suɗin se ahankali bazasu taba yin abunda sukayi yanzunba,aganinshi rashin lafiya tafi gaban komai,aganinshi ko makiyinka ne indai akazo tafarkin jinya dole ya sarara maka anma segashi nashi Ƴan uwan sunbashi mamaki lokaci guda,suncanza mai view dinshi gameda Ƴan uwan taka lokaci guda.

Dayanman ranar Gogode takoma Babban buli inda tayi tayi inbita anma naqi nace nida Baba zanzauna kuma har lokacin banbar zubda hawayeba hakanan naqi sakin hannun Baba koda kuwa na minti ɗaya ne. Da dare Kawu Hassan yafita yasiyo mana Koko da kosai yadawo,sanda yamin tayi kinci nayi nace naqoshi hakanan inaganinshi yazauna yaci abincin iyacinshi harsaida yakoshi sannan ya ajiyemin sauran.

Dana tambayeshi na Baba fah secemin yayi "ai anasamai drip bayama iya tashi bare ya iya cin abinci" wasu irin dummammun hawaye sukabi kan kuncina Ina tuno yanda Baba baya wasa da abinci,yana bama abinci ultimate respect,duk inda time ɗin three square meals ɗinnan sukayi zaibar komi yakeyi yadawo gida muci abinci,wataran innaki ci yayita lallashina yana rokona inci bayason ulcer takamani. Toh gashidai yauga abincin kuma lokacin cinta yayi anma babu halin tashi yaci.

Karfe takwas Yaya Salim yashigo ɗakin hannunshi riqe da ledan take awayn abinci dana fruits yasamu guri yazauna yana tambayar Kawu Hassan jikin Baba.
Kawu Hassan yace masa "Dasauki alhamdulillah" kafin yadubeni cikeda tausayawa yace "Rukayya kukan nandai bazakibarshi ba? do you want to hurt yourself by crying?" Jijjiga masakai nayi ahankali,daman tuncan shi mutumina ne akaf gidansu. bamusaba ba ko ada damuke gida ɗaya sabida boarding school yayi,hutu kawai muke haɗuwa shima ba sosai ba. Toh yanzu ma dayake jami'a bamu saba ba bakuma mutaba zama munyi hirar datakai na minti goma ba anma duksanda naje gidan indai yananan yaganni kuma toh zamu gaisa yatambayeni Baba fuska daukeda fara'a unlike the others shiyasa nake ganin darajarsa da girmansa sosai. Sauran Ƴan gidan kuwa,wasunsu inna samu hararama ingode Allah hakanan wasunsu ma ko kallo ban ishesuba,wasunsu kuma tsangwama da habaici kokuma azageni directly babu yanda na'iya. Shikaɗai yafita zakka, shikaɗai yake ganina da idon mutunci mugaisa lafiya lafiya.

Ledan abincin daya ajiye gefensa yashiga buɗewa tareda ciro take away ɗaya yamikama Kawu Hassan sannan yaciro ɗayan yafara buɗewa yana kallona yace "zokici abinci toh dukdama ba dahuwar gida bace,a restaurant Abba yabani nasiyo kinsan muna parking. Aunty da Ummi basuyi girkiba yau,abincin gidama duk a restaurant mukasaya. nasu yana mota inna tashi tafiya zanwuce musu dashi gida" nidai bancemasa komaiba dukda araina nagama raya yafaɗi hakanne just to make me feel better. Wata zuciyar tace "Shikuma miye nayimin karya bayan yafi kowa sanin nariga nasan halin yan gidansu,babu wanda yake kaunata dazaiyi min wannan hidimar,bandaisan mahaifina ba dukda mashi bacin abuncin yakeyi ba
