Satina ɗaya a asibiti tareda Baba kuma haryau babu wani cigaba a rashin lafiyar tasa sema abunda yayi gaba. hakanan kullum cikin baƙi muke,wasu daga Giyaɗe,wasu daga Babban buli wasu kuma daga nan cikin gari. Kullum ɗakin baya rabuwa da masu zuwa dubiya hakanan kowannensu zaizo seya taho da ɗan fruits ko drinks haka. Baba mutum ne me mutane fiyeda yanda me karatu zai kwatanta, gakuma fara'a dason kyautata ma al'aumma dukda kuwa karamin karfi nedashi. dayawa cikin customers ɗinshi dasuka saba cinikayya a kasuwa sun zazzo sun dubashi dasuka samu labarin rashin lafiyar tasa.

Acikin sati ɗayannan konan da nan bana matsawa daga gefen Baba,koda yaushe ina makale da hannunsa,inkaga natashi to bandaki zani kokuma sallah zanyi. Akwai ranar da Kawu Adamu yayi yayi inbisu gida dasukazo da dare shida Kawu idrissa bayan suntaso a aiki anma naqi dole yabarni bayan Kawu Sani yace masa aishima yayimin tayin akaini gidansa anma naqi sukyaleni kawai.

Tunda naji faɗan da Kawu Sani keyi gameda abunda Kawu idrissa da Kawu Adamu sukayi ma Baba naji natsanesu,naji inajin haushin su gaba ɗaya and it makes me wonder miyasa suke min murmushi akodayaushe idan sukazo,miyasa suke comforting ɗina dacewa Baba zaisamu lafiya insha Allahu bayan suna ɗaya daga cikin mutanenda sukayi wasa da lafiyarsa har na wurin sati guda. sedaga baya nalura dakyau,idan idon Baba biyune suke nuna sympathy akaina,suke comforting ɗina hakanan idan sukazo idanunshi biyu sunfi jimawa a ɗakin hakanan sundinga tambayar Hassan meda me likitan yace kokuma suyita tambayar Baba koyana bukatan wani abu and he'll just smiled sannan yagirgiza kanshi akan baya bukatar komai. Se abun yazo yana damuna,nafara tunanin miyasa suke yima Baba *Fuska biyu*,why are they showing their care in yana gani inkuma yayi bacci they never care. Kawu Sanin daya damu da Baban ma sincerely baicika zuwa yana samun Baba idonshi biyuba hakanan duk wasu wahalhalu dayakeyi bana tunanin Baba yasani dansu Kawu Adamu nunawa suke tare sukeyi masa komai a idonsa to which ni bansan daliliba.

Gida mukaje na tattari kayana dana Baba sannan muka rufe gidan muka kamo hanyar komawa asibitin sega kiran *Baba Hadiza* (Ummin su Yaya Salim) a wayarsa.

Kallon Yaya Zunnurain dake zaune kan kujerar dake kusa da bakin kofar parlourn yayi sannan yace "Zunnu ina Ummi?" Yaya Zunnurain yace "tana cikin ɗakinta" daganan yashige ciki yabarni tsaye gurin inajin su Yaya Zaheera namasa sannu da zuwa da alama ko lura dani basuyiba.

nidai tsaye nayi kamar wata gunki a bakin kofar parlourn kuma har haɗa idanu da Zunnu mukayi amma ko kala baiceminba sema kyabe baki dayayi yacigaba da kallonsa. Zaheera data tashi daga kwancen datake akan two seater tamatsa ma Yaya Salim yazauna tace "bamu masan tashiga ba inba yanzu dakake faɗa ba Yaya" Aisha tace "kumafa tun ɗazu kai take jira kazo kakai niqan wake inaga tagaji dajira shiyasa tashige wankan dandaman naji tana cewa zata fita unguwa" Yaya Salim yana wasa da makullin mota a hannunsa yace "niqa kuma?" Aisha tace "Eh Yaya,niqan wakene za'ayi alala dashi" Yaya Salim yace "yanzu niqan ne harsai ankirani ku bazaku iya kaiwaba?" Zaheera tace "Yaya babu injin niqa a unguwarnan wallahi,bakaga wahalar damukasha ba yaushiyasa" Aisha tace "niseda na gwammace bamuyi zancen muna kwadayin alala ba jiya da duk bamusha wahalar damukashaba yau" Zunnurain dariya yayi yana faɗin "maganinku ai. seku shirya missing kallon kabhi kush kabhi Gam dan ankusa farawa" Zaheera tace "Yaya Zunnu inamu kake ma bakin ciki to wallahi se inyi addu'ar Allah yasa adauke wutanma gaba ɗaya" Zunnurain yace "kiyi mana aini nataba kallon Film ɗin daman kune daman baku kallah ba" tura baki Zaheera tayi tana faɗin "koma miyene dai" and Yaya Salim couldn't stop laughing at them.

Nima bansan sanda nasaki murmushi ba ayayinda hawaye suka fara bin kunci na Ina tunanin inama nima inada yayu da kanne kamarsu,Ina ma inada wanda zan tsokana suji haushina kosuma su tsokaneni akan silly things kamar yanda sukeyi yanzu and carap idanuna suka sauka cikin na Yaya Salim dasauri nasa bayan hannuna nashiga goge kwallata sabida alkawarin dana masa bazan sake kukaba kwana uku dasuka wuce.

Ware idanu yayi yace "Rukayya daman baki zaunaba? Why are you standing over there?" dukansu suka juyo suna kallona banda Yaya Zunnurain da already yaganni tun ɗazu. Yaya Salim yace "zonan?" ****
Watan mu biyu a asibiti anma babu wani improvement ajikin Baba,babu kuma irin test ɗinda ba'ayi ba dan gano cuttuttukan da ake zargin Baba yana dashi anma kowanne se ace bashi bane. BP ma in an gwada normal,diabetes ɗinshi ma bashi bane. dafari anyi tunanin kidney problem ne akazo aka gwada bashi baneba,har test ɗin HIV seda akama Baba sabida symptoms dasuke gani anma duk bashi baneba. acikin kwanakinnan ma ko numfashi baya iyayi dakanshi dole seda akasakamai oxygen,acikin watanni biyunnan danayi tareda shi bazan iyace muku ga ranar danaji muryar saba,kama hannuna dayakeyi ada yana ɗan matsawa yanzu yadaina, signal dayakema masu zuwa dubiya adama yanzu yadaina sede yayita binku da idanu. komai najikinsa ya sauya,ya rame,ya tsomare kamar wanda babu nama ajikinsa. Kaman bashine healthy Babana dana saniba. acikin wata biyunnan sau ɗaya matan Kawu Sani suka zo suka duba Baba,Ya'yansu kuwa manya da kanana babu wanda yataba zuwa yadabushi inbanda Yaya Salim. Gidansu Kawu Adamu da Kawu idrissa kuwa tunda nazo basu zoba nadaiji Kawu Hassan yace sunzo saubiyu farkon admission ɗin Baba.

*Baffa Mallam* ( mahaifin Baba,Kakana) dukda irin tsufar dayayi sau hudu yana tattaki yana zuwa yaduba Baba. su Gogode da Baffa Idiii kuwa baswa sati biyu basu zosuba.

****
Kamar kullum yauma inazaune kan kujerar dake kusa da gadon Baba Ina kallonsa nazabga uban tagumi sekawai naga yasakar min murmushi. Mutstsuke idanuna nayi inason in tabbatar da abunda nagani ɗin and he's still smiling at me,washare hakwarana nayi sannan nashiga Ƙiran Kawu Hassan batareda nabar kallon fuskar Baba ba nace "Kawu Hassan kazo kaga Baba na murmushi" sede tunma kafin narufe bakina naji Baba yataba hannuna da hannunsa,hawaye nafarayi fuskata takasa boye excitement ɗinda nake ciki. ganin bakinshi danayi yana motsi tacikin oxygen ɗin yasani saurin tashi tsaye nakai kunnena kusa da kunnensa Ina faɗin "Ba..b..a mek..ake..son cewa....?" and I heard him saying "Ma..manaaa..." Cikin dasasshiyar muryarsa da dabadan nakai kunnena sosai ba bazanma ji meyake cewa ba,wani irin wawan runguma namasa nace "Babaaaaa kayi magana!!"" nayi maganar cikeda farin ciki ayayinda hawaye keta aikin fita daga idanuna da inada tabbacin wannan karan kukan farin cikine. 
Nurses ɗinda suka shigo ɗakin ne suka dagani daga jikinsa sunacewa mufita zasu dubashi Ashe Kawu Hassan yaje yayi calling attention ɗinsu tunbayan danayi masa magana.

( _The story of Rukayya_)

Written by *Zeeneert*💞

*Zeeneert*@wattpad

*Rukayya labarinta take bayarwa on the process yayinda nikuma zanna tabo muku bangaren other familys din sabida asamu fahimta sosai cikin labarin. So zakuna ganin changes a rubutun kadan*

*Page Fourteen*

*Second to the last free page*

Bayan munfito bamu jima tsaye wajeba sega ainahin likitan dayake dubashi yazo yashiga dakin shima. sunfi mintuna talatin a dakin kafin sukafito suna tattaunawa a tsakaninsu inda daga karshe likitan yadubi kawu Hassan ya tambayesa Ina kawu Sani.

Take Kawu Hassan ya sanardashi yatafi office kafin likitan yace "toshikenan inya zo kace yasameni a office ɗina" Kawu Hassan yace "toh" kafin suka tafi mukuma muka buɗe kofar ɗakin muka koma ciki. samu mukayi ancirema Baba na'urar dake taimaka mai wurin shan numfashi,dasauri na ƙarasa jikin gadon dayake kwance ina murmushi ganin yana breathing normally ayayinda nake shirin fashewa da kukan farin ciki nace "Babaaaa!" nafaɗa jikinshi nafara hawaye. Ahankali kamar me tsoron hannunshi naji yafara tapping bayana cikin muryarsa da bata fitowa clear yace "Mamana zaki karya Babane?" Dasauri natashi daga jikinshi Ina goge hawayena kafin nakoma nazauna kan kujerar dana saba zama sannan nakamo hannunshi nasaka cikin nawa ina faɗin "Baba nayi kewarka sosai" kallona Baba yayi sannan yace "nima haka Mamana. Kozamu tafi gidane? nasan kingaji dazaman asibiti koh?" yakarashe maganar playfully.

Cikin sauri nace "Bangaji da zaman asibiti ba sabida Ina tare dakai but still inason mukoma gida anma aiseka samu lafiya Koh?" gyaɗa min kai yayi ahankali yana murmushi,slowly nace "Babaaa" yace "Na'am Mamana" Kaman meshirin sake fashewa da kuka nace shine bakanemeni ba daka fara rashin lafiya. kayita jinyar ka kai kaɗai" yar dariya Baba yayi sannan yace "toh bagashi yanzu kinsani ba?" tura baki nayi gaba bansan daliliba sega wasu sabbin hawaye wanda inada tabbacin wannan karan bana farin ciki kamar dazu baneba  cikin kuka nace "Amma ai seda su Gogode suka kawoni sannan nasani" Baba yace "banason inyi spoiling hutunki by sending you a bad news Mamana. Koyanzu dakike zaune agabana ba ason raina bane,dandai banida yanda zanyine" sa bayan hannuna nayi ina share hawayena batareda na iyacewa komaiba. Baba na kallona har lokacin trying to comfort me yace "Mamana bana bazaki bani labarin hutunki a Babban buliba?" harlokacin Ina sauke ajiyar zuciya nace "toh ai bakada lafiya Baba" yayi murmushi yana wasa da hannuna yace "bagashi nasamu lafiya yauba tunda har Ina magana. Oya gist me about your holiday in Babban buli like you used to. bani labarin su Kwaiɗum,Hari,Bulo da su Hansai, faɗamin saunawa kukaje ɗiban kara,sau nawa kikaje surfe sannan tsaraban mesu Gogode suka baki kikawomin? Ina fatandai ba *Tumu* suka bakiba? dan nasan yanzukam ta bushe" yakarashe maganar ahankali cike da zolaya.

Tura baki nayi gaba sannan nace "aibasu faɗamin gunka zanzoba shiyasa bantaho maka da tsarabarkaba" yayi dariya sannan yace "gwanda dabaki zo dashi bama Mamana,nasan da asararta za'ayi" ahankali nace "eh" yace "toh inasu Kwaiɗum? abani labarinsu mana" murmushi nayi lokaci guda nazage kamar yanda nakebasa labari koda yaushe innadawo daga hutu daga Giyaɗe ko Babban Buli nace "Baba aiwannan hutun is so special,nayi sabbin abokanai da kawa guda ɗaya" Baba trying hard not to laugh yace "abokanai kuma? dama Mata na abokantaka da other gender ɗinsu ne Mamana?" nace "toh Yayu,nayi sabbin Yayu Baba" Baba yakasa ɓoye mamakinsa yace "Yayu kuma du? nasansu ne? A Babban buli suke?" Yajeromin tambayoyin duka lokaci guda a yayinda na girgiza masakai alamar a'a yace "toh a ina kikasansu" Ina murmushi nace "zuwa sukayi duba albarkatun ƙasa shine muka saba dasu" daganan nashiga bama Baba labarin yanda muka haɗu dasu Lamiɗo,dayanda nadinga binsu field har komawarsu makarantarsu.

Haka Baba yadinga Jin labarina,wani yayi dariya wani yayi murmushi,barinma danabashi labarin gold dakuma dirkowa da Lamiɗo yayi daga kan bishiya dakuma taramana akori kura dayakeyi ahanya kullum mutafi mubar sauran colleagues ɗinsa,dariya sosai yayi awurarennan. har labarin yace zehadani da ƴan gidansu seda nabashi,dayanda yabani contact ɗinsa ranar dazasu tafi babu abunda naboyema Baba kafin 
daga karshe nace "Baba yanzu Lamiɗo nata jirana in ƙirasa koh?" murmushi Baba yayi sannan yace "Mamana Miss curious!" dariya kawai nayi dandaman yasaba kirana da sunan innayi mishi irin tambaya haka.
Yace "bazan iyacemiki yana jiran kiranki kobaya jiraba tunda yaɗan kwana biyu dakika mai alkawarin Ƙiran but one thing is for sure,he must have expected your call kamar yanda kika masa alkawari" tura bakinayi gaba sannan nace "Toh Baba yanzu inka samu sauki muka koma gida zan iya kiranshi koh?" Baba yace "mezai hana. Indai kinada number shi zamukira,nima ingaisa da sabon Ɗana tunda ansani nazama Uban dole, Mamana tayi kyauta dani batare da izinina ba" Baba yakarashe maganar playfully. dariya nayi sannan nace "Baba ba kyautanka fah nabayarba canje zamuyi. Ni inbashi Baba shikuma yabani Ummanshi harda siblings" Baba yace "kicedai harda gyara da alokoro za'abaki" Kawu Hassan dake gefe yanajinmu shima seda yadara wannan karan.

Kafin daga karshe Baba yace "I wish I could meet him Mamana" cikin sauri nace "bazai zama Ɗan kaba zaka ganshi ai Baba" sekawai Baba yayi murmushi batareda yace komaiba. haka nacigaba da bashi labaran abubuwan dasuka faru a Babban buli haryayi bacci

***
*GOMBE*

Tafiya yake kan babban titin dake cikin garin Gombe hakanan yanda yake tafiya out of fear cikin salasainar darennan zebaka mamaki ba kaɗan ba. tunda yabaro arean gidan kallon wasan kwallo dayaje yadaina jin hayaniyar mutane kwata kwata,inbanda kukan karnuka babu abunda kakeji. Ko'ina shiru kamar babu wasu hallitu masu suna mutum cikin garin wanda hakan zai tabbatar maka da cewa darene sosai,dare mahutan bawa. lokacin da Allah ya ware mana don muhuta duk wata gajiyar damuka kwaso da rana anma abangaren Lamiɗo abun bahaka yakeba. tafiya yadingayi harya iso gaban makeken gate ɗin masarautar Gombe. sanɗa yashigayi ahankali kamar wani barawo harya isa dabda buli bulin gate ɗin masarautar yafara leƙen harabar masarautar takowani angle yana analyzing ta'ina zaisamu yashiga batareda dogarayen dasuka gama zagaye masauratar sun kamashiba. Seda yagama plan ɗin yanda zeshige gidan sannan yabar gurin cikin sanɗa,haka yadinga bin jikin katangar ta barin arewa harya isa karshen katangar,yatsaya  naɗan wasu daƙiƙu kafin yakama jikin katangar yahau slowly tayanda baza'a ji motsinsaba harya gama hawa,yazauna kan katangar kafafunshi nata cikin masauratar yana karema ko'ina kallo.

Dogarayen dake tsattsaye gabanshi a filin masarautar sunjiyamai baya yadinga kallo yana ƴar dariyar mugunta ƙasa ƙasa ahankali yace "shegu duk bacci sukeyi a tsattsaye gobe kuma suzo suna claiming bravity suna ma mutane burga" Lamiɗo seda yagama hutawanda yanada tabbacin da gadin gaske dogarayen keyi da waɗanda ke other side of the wall na masauratar da suke fuskantarsa zasu ganshi zaune kan katangar anma dake ba aikin gadin suke dagaske ba babu wanda yaganshi kuma bayau yafara shigowa haka ba da ikon Allah kuma babu wanda yataba kamashi cikinsu.

Leƙa kansa yayi ƙasa don samu yaɗaura kafarsa kan drum ɗinda yasaba sauka takai kullum anma da mamakinsa babu komai a gurin,wani irin zare idanu yayi yana sake kallon gurin ko gezau idanunsa keyimasa anma still babu drum ɗin,yasa hannu ya mitstssike idanunsa yabuɗe nanma babu. dafe kirji yayi ahankali yana tunanin yau kashinsa ya bushe,yanzu fisabilillahi wani shegen ne yaɗauke drum ɗinnan?wani ɗan bakin cikin ne da son tona masa asiri ne yaɗauke drum ɗinda ke rufa masa asirin shekara da shekaru?. aransa tsinema wanda yamai wannan aika aikan yadingayi kafin yayi kwafa yatashi ya tsaya da kafafunsa akan katangar yana faɗin "inkunsan wata bakusan wataba" kafin yayi Bismillah yadaka wani irin tsalle yadira cikin gidan kafin yakwasa aguje ganin dogarayen dake tsatsaye duksun firgita da unexpected diran dayayi musu. 
Kankace me masaurautar ta kacame da hayaniyar guje gujen da akeyi tsakanin Lamiɗo da dogaraye,gudu yake sosai,gudun dashikanshi besan ya'iyaba seyau ayayinda dogarayen kebinshi abaya,wasu tagabanshi suke taroshi anma seya zilleh.
Waziri dabekai gayin bacciba yana sallan dare yajiyo hayaniya da guje gujen da ake yi daga waje yasashi ƙarasa raka'an dayakeyi ya sallame sallar sannan yafito yabuɗe kofar parlournsa daniyar tambayan dogarayen dake filin gidansa meyake faruwa anma da mamakinsa babu ko ɗayansu afilin gidan,da alama suma sunje anemi culprit ɗin tareda su.

Juyawa yayi daniyar amsa mai ɗakinsa dayanzu fitowarta daga ɗaki Itama tana tambayar meyafaru kawai yaji an bangajeshi anwuce aguje,kan ya ankara sega dogaraye sunfi akirga suna tururuwa suna bangajeshi suna shiga gidan nashi batareda sunlura da wanene tsaye gurinba suna faɗin "Ku kamashi! Ku kamashi barawo ne . Lamiɗo dai ɗakin dayagani gabansa abude yayi sauri yashige,yasaka makulli taciki yana haki kafin cikin sauri ya ƙarasa jikin windown ɗakin yana addu'ar Allah yasa irin windunan gidan sune,sabida yasaba dirka ta windown ɗakinsa in bayason Umma tasan baya gida.

Bayan gidansu daya tabbatar babu mutane gurin yazagaya yasauya rigar jikinsa sannan yakoma kofar gidannasu. madaidaicin gidane acikin masaurautar dake ɗaukeda madaidaicin parlourn da babu kujeru cikinsa se *Tum tum* irinna kwalliyar parlourn nan dake jejjefe ƙasa takowani angle na parlourn sekuma TV da DVD dake ajiye kan Tv stand inda kan DVD ɗin an ajiye several catset na films ɗin Hausa. jikin wall ɗin parlourn kuwa akwai madaidaicin agogon bango dake manne ta gefen gabar,inda daga kasan wall clock ɗin kuwa karamar firiji ne ajiye. ɗakuna ukune agidan wanda kowannensa na ɗaukeda banɗaki acikinsa. ɗaya na Umma,ɗaya nasu Jidda inda ɗaya kuma na Lamiɗo ayanzu wanda ada ɗakin mahaifinsane bayan rasuwarsa da jimawane Umma tasashi yayi parking yakoma ɗakin dazama. se ƴan madaidaiciyar kitchen da store ɗinda ke ɗaukeda kayan amfaninsu dede talaka dede gwargwado. A parlour suka samu su Umma zaune gaban trayn biskin alkama da hadaddiyar miyar taushen da kamshinsa yagama gauraye parlourn baki ɗaya.  Lamiɗo gefen Umma yazauna yana lumshe idanu yana shakar kamshin abincin yace "wannan sweet aroma ɗindai nasan girkin Umma ne banakowa ba" dariya sukayi dukansu Basma tace "toh ba Umma bace tayi. ninayi girkinnan Hamma Lamiɗo" Jidda riƙe haba tayi tana kallon Basma sannan tace "Kaiii Adda Basma bafa ke kikayi ba" hararanta Basma tayi jidda tadubi Umma tace "Umma inake kikayi girkinnan tunda ke kika haɗa komai da komai?" Lamiɗo yace "yarinyar dana baku labari farkon dawowa na daga field Umma" cikin saurin Umma tace "Yanzu daman baka hakura da batun yarinyarnan ba Lamiɗo? banace maka tunda basu kiraba kamanta da batunta kacigaba da harkokin gabanka ba? ita data damu kahadata damu miyasa bata kiraba?" Jiddah dake zaune gefen Basma ganin Lamiɗo yanufi kofa zai fita tace "Hamma karka manta tsarabata" Lamiɗo na dariya yace "Insha Allahu bazan mantaba" kafin yafice agidan yanajin Salma na mitar in ankawo tsarabar Itama saitaci yau,ai Jidda ba'ita kaɗai bane kanwar Lamiɗon.

kwana biyu kenan dacire oxygen ajikin Baba kuma alhamdulillahi jikinshi yayi sauki sosai fiyeda yanda kuke tsanmani,koda yaushe Ina tareda shi muna hira bana motsawa ko'ina. yau tun safe Baba yasa Kawu Hassan yaje gida yaɗauko masa wayarsa kan yanason yayi important call,da Kawu Hassan yakawo wayar seda akasakata a chargi tacika sannan akabama Baba amma da mamakina sebeyi kiran dayaketa zumuɗin zeyiba. 

Da daredai dasu Kawu idrissa sukazo suna hira dashi naji yace musu duka yanason ganinsu gobe dasafe in Allah yakaimu kuma akwai mutumin dazaizo masa da sako duk a goben.

Kawu idrissa da Kawu Adamu sukace Allah yakaimu goben yasa muji alkhairi.

Lamiɗo yana fita agida straight majalisarsu dake cikin unguwa yawuce dan yasan acanne kaɗai zaisamu Hafiz a irin wannan lokacin. Sonake ka tabbatar mata cewa she exists" Hafiz da mamaki yace "Wace Ƴar birnin?" danshikam yama manta da babin yarinyar kwata kwata inba yanzu da Lamiɗo yaɗauko maganarba.

Lamiɗo yace "Ƴar birni daya dai dakasani" Hafiz yace "kana nufin yarinyar damuka haɗu da'ita a Babban buli damukaje field work?" Lamiɗo yace "bayan ita kasan wata da ake kira da Ƴar birnin ne?" I don't love her,she's too small for me. kawai inason incika alkawarin dana ɗauka matane na cewa zan hadata da family na sabida ita batada su" Hafiz cikeda mamakin Lamiɗo yace "bangane ba? Kamarya batada family? akwai wanda bashida family ne arayuwarnan daman?" 

Lamiɗo yace "bazaka ganeba ba daman. She's only a Father, mahaifiyarta tun awurin haihuwarta tarasu,meaning she's no siblings. she's the only child to her parents shine takeson inhaɗa ta da Umma dasu jiddah,she want to experience the joy of having a Mother and siblings" wannan karan Hafiz dariya ya sheke da sannan yace "ikon Allah" Lamiɗo harara yabi Hafiz dashi sannan yace "Ohhh dariya ma magana ta yabaka kenan?" Hafiz yace "Dole inyi dariya Lamiɗo,the thing sounds childish to me. ta'ina zaka fara ɗaukar maganar Ƴar kankanuwar yarinya irin Ƴar birni harka sama kanka? koka taba Jin inda familyn wani yazama na wata dakecan wata uwa duniya? tukunnanma Ina nata family ɗin?apart from her Father dole akwai dangin mahaifinta dana mahaifiyarta damuka tarar a Babban buli. duk sukadai basu Isa subata love experience na sisters da mahaifiya ba sekai dakake dangin badalo? kaida bama zaman kanka kakeyiba bare ace zaka iya adopting dinta. amabar maganar adoption sabida it's out of option tunda ba'a ophanage kagantaba,tareda danginta kaganta. Uwa,kanni da yayu kawai tarasa danake da tabbacin cousins dinta can fill up that gap so stop feeling guilty for anything,maganace Ƴar birni tamaka Irinna yarinta bayan shi babukomai acikinsa" Hafiz yace "Aiko maganar gold datayi tadinga binmu tana wahalar dakanta akan unassured dreams ma kaɗai ya'isa yanuna maka yarintar Ƴar birni kararara wanda dakayi wannan tunanin you'll never take her words onto your heart" Lamiɗo dayayi shiru tun ɗazu yanajin bayanan Hafiz bawai don yana gamsuwa da maganar tasaba yace "I even gave her my number akan zata kirani kaga kuma haryanzu bata kiraba" Hafiz yace "toh kagani? duk cikin yarintarne. bazai wuce tayarda papern awani guriba tama manta da babinka kai kazonan kana tada hankalinka" Lamiɗo boldly yace "I don't believe cewa tamanta dani,I don't believe tayarda papern on purpose sede in bata yayi mistakenly kokuma something is wrong with her" Lamiɗo yakalli Hafiz yace "in her eyes naga how she desperately wanted to make my family her own,in her eyes I saw the truest sincererity ɗinta shiyasa kaga nadamu inkoma gareta. I don't want to cut her dreams as a young child,inma rasa number tayi I'll go there and give her the number again shiyasa nakeson inje Babban buli gobe. Innaje can nasan za'a haɗani dawanda zaikaini har gidansu shiyasa nake nemar taimakonka Hafiz. I told Umma about Nana tun dawowana wanda alokacin takarbi maganar wholeheartedly takuma ɗaukeshi amatsayin yarinta irinna yara kamar yanda kaima kaɗauko but still she didn't stopped my intentions,infact she was ready to talk to her tawaya sugaisa amma tunda Nana tazo bata kiraniba sanda tayi alkawari Umma tace kar insake maganarta agida ganin nadamesu. tace kilan tabatar da layinne kokuma tama manta da batuna so inbar maganar kawai Allah beyi zasu gaisan ba but I didn't listen,I kept expecting her call everyday batareda nasake yin maganarta agida ba harwayana yasamu matsala namaida simcard ɗina cikin wayar Umma sabida kawai kada takira taji layina akashe. toh yanzu sati biyu dayin hakan kenan,Kuma kullum sede inbanshiga gida ba sena tambayi Umma ko ankirani da sabon layi wanda hakan yasata zargin something is fishy,yau ta ritsa ni da tambayoyi wanda dole seda na amsa mata kasandai ni inba abunda yashafi makarantataba banayima Umma karya bana kuma boye mata komai. atakaice dai yanzu Umma kallon aljana takema Ƴar birni shiyasa nakeson kaje kafaɗa mata kaima kasanta please,daganan se insan yanda zanyi in lallabata tabarni inje Babban buli gobe" Hafiz yace "wallahi dabadan nasan yarinyar nanba nima cewa zanyi aljana ce.   how can such a small child have so much impact on you Lamiɗo?"  Lamiɗo dai dariya yayi sannan yace "wallahi nima bansaniba Haifiz. May be sabida irin sabon da mukayine na tsawon kwanaki" Hafiz yace "but still. That shouldn't be a genuine reason" Lamiɗo yace "nidai yanzu ba wannan ba,kataimaka mujemu gida kacema Umma kasan Ƴar birni nikuma daganan zansan yanda zanyi in lallabata tabarni inje kauyen Babban buli gobe" Hafiz yace "mujemu tunda ba karya zan gindayaba iyakar gaskiyata zanfada aida sauki" Dariya sukayi dukansu ayayinda suka cigaba da nufar kofar masauratar Gombe.

Do you think Umma zatabar Lamido yaje Babban buli? will destiny unite them?

*Bonus page*

*ASALIN LAMIƊO*

Mallam Yusuf Kwami tilon Ɗa ne agurin iyayensa shiyasa suka ɗauki son duniyarnan suka ɗaura masa,dukwani abuna rayuwa dayake bukata yimashi sukeyi batareda suntaba tunanin yanda zaiyi building future ɗinshi ba,aganinsu he's their only child so babu abunda bazasu iyayi masa dakansu ba shiyasama basu taba damuwa da yaje yanemi abun kansa ba inbanda noma dayake taya mahaifinsa in lokacin damuna yayi har yakai shekaru ashirin aduniya wanda alokacin ne mahaifiyar sa tadage seyayi aure sabida tanason ganin jikokinta Itama tunda Allah bai azurtata dasamun Ƴaƴa dayawaba. Awannan lokacin Yusuf ko budurwa bayidashi danshi ba mutum bane me hayaniya da kalle kalle even though he was pampered by his parents,naturally shi mutum ne me sanyi dakuma rashin yawan magana shiyasa ma baka taba gane meyake so dawanda bayaso,shidai kawai se abunda iyayensa suka ɗaura sa akai yakeyi wanda wannan dalilin yasa mahaifiyar sa tayi deciding sunema masa auren Ƴar yayarta *Amina* wanda cikin lokaci kankani akayi biki Amina tatare agidan Mijinta Yusuf. Dukda auren haɗin gida akayi musu they accepted it wholeheartedly,cikin lokaci kankani suka fahimci juna kuma suke zaman lafiya cikeda so da kaunar juna. shekara biyu da aurensu anma Allah baibama Amina haihuwaba gakuma matsalar rashin abunyi da Yusuf ke fama dashi,indai ba lokacin Noma ba toh kullum yana kwance agida se abunda mahaifiyarsa Hauwa'u ta girka takawo musu gashi yanzu jikin Baban nasa dayake fita yanema musu abunda zasuci dinma babu daɗi sosai. Kusan kullum yanacikin rashin lafiya abunka da tsufa wanda hakan yatada hankalin Amina,tasan in one way or other dai dole wataran sesun nemi na gashin kansu bazaiyuyu suyita depending akan iyayensuba kullum kuma Yusuf ɗinma na iya bakin ƙoƙarin shi wurin ganin yanemi aiki anma abun yaci tura wanda wannan dalilin yasa Amina ma ta cigita masa cikin yayunta ko Allah zaisa yasamu abunyi daga bangarensu dake duk manyane kuma kowannensu nada abunyi. Alokacin cewa sukayi babu anma in ansamu zasuyi mata magana.

Cikin ikon Allah kuwa ba'ajima ba watarana sega yayanta *isiyaku* yazo hargida yakawo ma Mallam Yusuf tayin aiki inyana sonyi anma da sharaɗin bafa acikin Kwami bane aikin acan masarautar Gombe ne wanda kuma dole zaikoma can dindin din dazama. Without thinking twice Mallam Yusuf ya karbi aikin hannu bibbiyu dankuwa yajima yana neman aikin ruwa a jallo yanzu kuma dayasamu bazai bari ya kubuce masaba so far as akwai goyin bayan iyayensa. Cikin wata guda yatattara shida Amina suka koma cikin masarautar Gombe inda akabashi *Sarkin Dawakai* wato mekula da duk wata harka data shafi dokunan masarautar inda yake zuwa Kwami akai akai yana duba iyayensa dakai musu ɗan abunda ba'a rasaba in aka biyashi hakkinsa. shekaransu biyu a Gombe Allah yakarbi ran mahaifinsa inda bayan anyi zaman makoki angama Yusuf yaso mahaifiyarsa tadawo cikin garin Gombe suzauna tare anma taƙi fir wai ita bazata bar asalintaba,a Kwami aka haifeta kuma acan za'a binneta in lokacinta yayi. dole Yusuf yahakura yacigaba da zuwa ganinta akai akai kuma alokacin  Amina nada tsohon ciki, haihuwa yau ko gobe.

wani irin shakuwa ne me tsafta tsakanin Sarki da Mallam Yusuf dankuwa Mallam Yusuf is very loyal and simple kowa nayimasa wannan yabon a masarautar,bazaka tabajin anyi aikin algus taredashiba wanda hakan yasa Sarki ya yarda dashi sosai harma wani sa'in yakansa Mallam Yusuf aikin dabai shafi dawakan masarautarba. anacikin haka Amina tafara naquda agida wanda Sarki dakanshi yabada mota aka kaita asibiti. tafi twelve ours tana wahala bata haihu ba wanda hakan yasa likitocin sukayi deciding ayimata aiki,haka Mallam Yusuf yasaka hannu aka shigada Amina ɗakin tiyata. Cikin awanni biyu segashi tahaifi Ɗanta namiji kyakyawa son kowa ƙin wanda yarasa. Kwanansu biyu a asibiti aka sallammeta suka dawo gida. Sarki har asibiti yazo yaduba Amina kafin a sallamesu hakanan sanda suke asibitin abinci ma daga cikin nasa yasa ake diba ana kawo musu asibitin hakanan duk wasu expenses na asibitin shiya biya. ana gobe suna ma yasayi rago yasa akai har kofar Mallam Yusuf yace ace masa gudumawarsa ta bikin sunane wannan wanda hakan yasa Mallam Yusuf Jin nauyin saka sunan wani bana Sarkin ba dankuwa he's done alot for him da bakowane zai iyayin wannan ba. Abunda baisani ba shi Sarki arayuwarsa yanason mutum mai Amana, riƙon gaskiya dakuma sanin yakamata wanda tunda suka fara aiki da Mallam Yusuf Sarki yalura Mallam Yusuf nada waɗannan qualities ɗin yaji yana sonshi haka kawai shiyasa yake masa waɗannan hidindimun bawai don wani abuba. Ranar suna akasakama yaro sunan Sarki *Isma'il* inda ake kiranshi da *Lamiɗo* sabida a sakaya sunan.

Tun bayan haihuwar Lamiɗo Amina batasake haihuwaba harseda Lamiɗo yayi shakaru shida cip aduniya sannan tahaifi Ƴa mace akasaka mata suna *Basma* daganan kuma setacigaga da haihuwar ƴaƴa mata ajere,bayan shekara biyu ta haifi Jidda sekuma bayan wani shekara biyun tahaifi autarta Salma daganan kuma tace zata huta tukunnan dayake kuma batada rabon sake haihuwar se Allah baiyiba.

Lamiɗo yarone kyakyawa dashegen shigarai tun yana dan kankaninsa and yet stubborn dankuwa tunda yafara rarrafe baka isa kashiga ɗakin Umma kaganshi fes fes ba,dan haka ze birkice ɗakin yakoma kamar na mahaukanta, yaɗale nan yaɗale can,yayi wurgi dawannan yayi wurgi da wancan. daya fara tafiya kuwa sema abunda yaƙaru akan nada. duk stubbornness ɗinsa kuwa bayida neman tsokana hakanan bazaka taba ji yayi faɗa da wani ba infact abokanansa sonsa sukeyi kamarmi,farin jini ne dashi tunyana ɗan kankaninsa. babba da yaro kowa sonshi yakeyi.

Sanda Lamiɗo yafara wayau akasaka shi a both islamiya da Boko wanda alokacinne Amina da Baffa sukaga typical darunsa dankuwa tunda yalura anfara kaishi makaranta da gari ya waye Umma tazo zata ɗaukeshi tamishi wanka zaifara zunduma ihu yana kuka har atafi makarantar dashi ahaka zaita kukan harlokacin tashi yayi. Lamiɗo yaƙi jinin zuwa makarantar boko abun mamaki kumase bayakin na islamiyyar

Amina dafari tashi hankalinta yayi ganin irin rigimar da Lamiɗon keyi,samun Mallam Yusuf tayi da batun kodai ahakura da makarantar ne tukunna harzuwa sanda zaikara waysu tunda Lamiɗon bayaso anma Mallam Yusuf yaƙi yace with time zaisaba. Sede fah Lamiɗo har aka gama first term baidaina wannan kukan banzan dayakeyi ba hakan kuma baisa andaina kaishi makarantar ba. Lamiɗo dayazo yaga kukan batayi mishi amfanin koma seya canza lauje. Duksanda yaji yanajin kashi ko fitsari seya ƙi faɗa ma nanny ɗinsu sede yayi a wando kokuma seya daidaici anfita break ko games seyazo yasamu kan table ɗin Auntynsu yatsuguna yayi yagudu abunsa and that'll keep her busy cleaning her table bazatayi musu lesson ba ranar wanda hakan bakaramin daɗi yake mishi ba,haka zai kwanta yayita baccinsa a aji,akumayi bincike amma ba'a sanin shiyayi sabida babu wani trace dayake bari,rana ɗaya dai Allah yatoni asirinsa yatsuguna kan table ɗin auntyn kenan segata tashigo class ɗin tayi mantuwa. ranar kuwa Lamiɗo yabugu ba kaɗan ba haka yayita kuka kamar zaiyi yaya. har ƙara Auntynsu takaishi gida inda Baffa yace "aibayason karatu ne makarantar ma dayaya akasamu yadaina kukan zuwa shiyasa ya fara wannan iskancin amma nan gaba inyasake shashanci irin haka ku basa kashi gobe bazai ƙara ba" and from that day onwards Auntynsu tazuba mishi idanu sosai,ta kulla mai,komai zata tambaya a class ɗin shitake tambaya inbai bada amsa ba kuwa yadinga shan punishment da bulala kenan wanda hakan yasa yake tsoronta sosai,intana koyar da abu dolenshi yake mayar da hankalinshi yakoya ahaka harya gama nursery school dan itake koyar dasu harsuka gama Nursery level. daman atsarin makarantar kowani set da da teachern dake coaching ɗinsu harsu gama leven ɗin dasuke ciki kafin takoma baya taɗauki wasu set ɗin kuma  Toh Aunty chioma ita takoyar da set ɗinsu Lamiɗo a Nursery level and that was how yasamu good foundation dukda kuwa rashin son karatunsa. Lamiɗo sanda yashiga primary level harda murnarsa yarabu da alakakai anma da mamakinshi ranar dasukayi resuming primary one bayan an tashi daga school yana isa gida bayan yagama lunch sega ta tazo gida yimasa lesson wanda Baffa dakansa yanemi wannan request ɗin agurinta danyasan ita kaɗai zata ita dealing dashi indai aharkar karatune. Dole Lamiɗo yamaida hankali akan karatun primary school ɗinma sabida kullum tana zuwa zatace yaɗebo books ɗinsa yakawo daganan kuma yashiga uku da questions kenan inbai amsaba kuma duka.

Babu abunda Lamiɗo bema Aunty chioma ba danta baryimasa lesson anma taki,yasha sace takalminta yaje yajefa a shadda intazo gida lesson yace bashi bane ba anma hakan baihanata cigaba da zuwaba,akwai ranarda yasa su Hafiz suzo sucire mata attach din kanta intana cikin masa lesson su gudu dukdan de tayi zuciya tadaina zuwa anma duk abanza.
Dole Lamiɗo yahakura yacigaba dazuwa makaranta dukda kuwa har ransa baso yakeyiba hardai yasamu yagama primary school yayi junior secondary school duk itakemai lesson. Alokacin ne kuma akayi babban rashi amasarautar,Sarki da Mallam Yusuf dakuma wasu daga cikin fadawan masarautar Allah yakarbi ransu sakamakon hadarin mota dasukayi ahanyarsu nazuwa wani taro dazasuje a Nijar. anyi kukan rashi bama a masarautar kaɗai ba harma a faɗin jihar gombe baki ɗaya,bayan angama zaman makoki dadai sauransu lokaci guda kuma abubuwa suka canza a masarautar baki ɗaya sakamakon canjin mulki da'aka samu. Amina abubuwa suka rikiɗe mata,ga rashin mijinta abun kaunarsu itada ƴaƴanta gakuma responsibilities dayahau kanta wanda ada batasan komai ba inbanda akawo tagirka,suzauna itada ƴaƴanta suci toh haka suturama dan babu abunda Mallam Yusuf ya ragesu dashi,komai yimasu yake dede gwargwado dede karfinsa. Bayan kuɗin lesson dayake biya azo ayi musu agidama both islamiya da Boko duk private yasakasu,a Inda zasu samu ingantacciyar ilimi wanda itakanta bayan rasuwar mijin nata bataso ciresu amakarantun ba anma data dubs yanayin rayuwa dakuma halin dasuka tsinci kansu aciki dole seda tayi hakan,gashi ita ba aikin fari bare na baƙi. gashi basuda maiyi musu batun tace zata koma Kwami ma duk ba solution bane sabida daga ita har ƴaƴanta sunsaba da rayuwar birni and moreover insunje can ɗinma liability zasu zame ma family ɗinsu wanda dole daga ƙarshe tayi deciding tatashi tanemi abunyi dakanta kawai for the betterment of her children's future. Aminiyarta *Hajiya Hadiza* dasuke zuwa islamiyar manya tare ne tabata shawarar why not ta koyi ɗinki tunda taga masu yi suna samu sosai seta haɗa da kitson da ada takeyinshi for free tamaida shi na kuɗi for the time being kafin aga abunda Allah zaiyi. Aikuwa hakan Amina tayi dan acikin satin taje tayi register da makarantar da ake koyon ɗinki tafara zuwa while on the other hand kuma tanayin kitson kuɗi agida. Dake tamaida hankali sosai akan abun takuma maida shi priority ɗinta within no time takoyi ɗinki dan tunma kafin agama training ɗin tasayi keken ɗinkin tana practice dashi agida during her free time. Kan kace me Amina tazama chief tailor a unguwarsu harma wasu daga wani unguwannin sukan kawo mata ɗinki har gida gakuma kitso data haɗa duka tanayi lokaci guda. toh da wadannan sana'o'in Amina ke kula da iyalinta dede gwargwado dukda kuwa taso tayi fulfilling needs ɗinsu kamar yanda mahaifinsu kemusu abun ya faskara,dan kuɗin ma bawai koda yaushe akesamu ba in ansamu ɗinma akwai so many budgets akansu, shiyasa akullum suka zauna da yaran takan ce musu "kuyi hakuri da irin canjin dakuke gani a rayuwarku. wannan ɗin wata jarabawa ce daga Ubangiji,wani yana can dazai samu irinnamu halin rayuwar zuba ruwa zaiyi akasa yasha. kuzama masu gode ma Allah akodayaushe and if you want a better future dole sekun dage kunyi karatu"

Masalar Amina ɗaya ce "rashin son karatun Lamiɗo" duk dukan dayasha agurin Aunty Chioma abanza. dankuwa yanzu yakoma gidan jiya tun bayan data sallami Aunty chioma tun daganan kuma ya watsar da karatun agefe,makaranta ma seyaga dama yake zuwa wanda hakan ba karamin ɗaga mata hankali yakeyiba,barinma inta tuna irin burin da Mallam Yusuf yaci akan Lamiɗon nason yayi karatu yazama independent mutum bawai yadogara da wasuba, yazama head of the family tayanda zaikula da kannensa da itakanta mahaifiyartasa anma kwata kwata shi ta lura waɗannan ba sune dreams ɗinsa ba. Amina tarasa miyasa Lamiɗo ke ƙin karatun bawai kuma don bashida ilimin baneba. Sau tari takan zaunar dashi tayimasa wa'azi anma his only answer will be "Umma bakaratu ne kaɗai kesa mutum yayi kuɗi ba. ko masu kuɗin duniya ma ba tahanyar karatun sukayi achieving abunda suka zama yanzuba. Besides the way we're living our lives is quite okay,ni i'm not after money. I want to lead a simple life,munada wadatarzuci,munada abinci dede gwargwado and above all we love each other wanda inada yakinin wannan bond ɗinda ke tsakanin mu will always keep us going" Umma intaji Lamiɗo yayi irin maganarnan setace "Toh Lamiɗo inbakayi karatun ba mezakayi?kaida ba jarin kasuwanci garekaba,kaida ba fita neman kuɗin kakeyi ba ta'ina zaka iya gina kanka bare har kayi leading simple life ɗin? ni aidaman bacewa nayi seka zama bilget ko dangote ba,a'a kadai zama kanada rufin asirinka. nimadai kasan nafara tsufa koh? kuma yau in Allah yakarbi raina waye zaikulada ku inbanda kaidin?" Lamiɗo dayaji Umma tafara maganar mutuwa irin haka seyace "Umma Insha Allah you're going  nowhere,insha Allah bazaki barmuba munanan taredake harsaikinga jikokinki" and she'll laughed setace "toh nadaina batun mutuwar da bakaso d6in anma fah batun karatu bazan bar yimaka itaba sabida azamanin yanzunnan inbakayi karatun ba wazai kalleka da idon daraja? wazaiyi dakai? kanadai gani mahaifinku ma dabadan masarauta yasamu yake aikiba da haryau munacan Dukku muna rarraba idanu" Lamiɗo se yace "karki damu Umma nima Inna girma I'll be lucky like Baffa,insha Allahu zansamu aikin dazanyi harya riqemu nida ku" Umma abudaya talura da lamido.

Shi mutum ne dabashida dogon buri,he just want a simple life. Shi mutum ne da abun duniya baidameshiba dankuwa tun yana kankaninshi ma baiyi halin kwaɗayi ba,yanada ɗauke kai akan abun wani hakanan duk abunda tadauka tabashi ko baiyi masa kyauba bazaiyi korafi ba,zai buɗi baki yayi godiya.

Sau tari zatadauki kuɗin break tabasu inzasu tafi makaranta kuma equally take basu dasu jidda anma still suda suke kanana sukanyi korafi anma banda Lamiɗo. ko naira biyar zata bama Lamiɗo bazaitaba cewa "Umma kuɗin nan bazai isheni ba" hakanan duk inda yaga abu maikyau na amfani kokuma kayan daɗi dayasan kanninsa naso koda kuwa da kuɗin break dinnasa ne zaisaya musu yakawomasu gida toh haka Umman ma indai yaga abu tana kuma son abun indai akwai kuɗi ahannunshi zaisaya yakawomata.

Kannenshi kuwa komi suka tambayeshi indai yana dashi zaibasu,zaikuma yimasu hakanan he's not strict on them, shakuwa ce sosai atsakaninsu wanda hakan kuma baisa sun rainashiba dan Amina batayi wasa wurin basu tarbiyya ba. in yace musu bari toh sunbari kenan,inyace yi kaza,take zasuyi batareda sunyi korafi ba. 

Lamiɗo yana Ss2 aka kawo letter daga school ɗinsu kan ana neman parents ɗinshi dasuje makarantar akwai maganar da akeson yi dasu. Amina da taga letter daga makarantarsu Lamiɗo kuma magana ce za'ayi akan Lamiɗon bakaramin damuwa tashiga ba dantasan bazai wuce laifi Lamiɗon yayi ba,hakadai tadaure tashirya tatafi makarantar. har cikin office ɗin principal secretary ɗin principal ɗin taraka Amina mahaifiyar Lamiɗo inda principal ɗin yanuna mata kujera yace mata "Bismillah Madam ki zauna" zama Amina tayi tana gaida principal ɗin ya amsa kafin tasanar dashi itace mahaifiyar Lamiɗo da aka turama letter gida kan ana neman parents ɗinsa. Principal yace "Allah sarki. Ina mahaifinsa?" Amina sauke kanta ƙasa tayi jiki sanyaye tace "Allah yayi mishi rasuwa shekaru biyu dasuka wuce" Principal cikeda tausayinta yace "I'm sorry. Allah ubangiji yayi mishi rahama" Amina tace "Amin bakomai" daganan principal ɗin yashiga faɗa mata dalilin kiran nata yace "Daman munkirakine gameda Ɗan ki Isma'il" cikeda damuwa Amina tace "wani abun yamuku ne Sir?" principal yace "eyi wallahi. Isma'il yakoyi rashin ji kwanannan Madam. yana skipping classes akai akai,anyi test yayi missing har guda biyu kuma beje yanemi amasa makeup test ba haryau sannan yana soyayya da ƴan matan junior section bayan any sort of relationship a school ɗinnan is prohibited,last time da aka kawomin kararsa naduba record ɗinsa tundaga primary school haryagama junior secondary school anma ba'a taɓa kamashi da laifiba wanda wannan dalilin yasa nabashi suspension na one week kaɗai thinking that he'll mind ways after the suspension but instead of yadaina sema abunda yaƙaru shiyasa nayi requesting parents ɗinsa suzo. Is he under the influential of new friends? tunda dai da bayayi" Amina da hankalinta yagama kai kololuwa atashi tace "A'a abokanansa nada dasu yake tare haryanzu" principal yace "then why the sudden change from him?" Amina cikeda damuwa tace "wallahi bansani ba principal. Amma nayi maka alkawarin bazai sake ba Insha Allahu zanyi mashi magana" Principal yace "gwanda dai kimishi maganar kam kuma yakamata kijashi ajiki sosai sabida kinasanin in and out ɗinsa. yaran yanzu se ahankali, kahaifi Ɗa ne baka haifi halinsa ba" Amina tace "haka nekuma. nagode sosai principal" principal yace "bakomai kidaiyi ƙoƙari kiɗauki mataki dan inbai gyara halayensa ba we've no any Other option than mu koreshi sabida sabida in aka barshi other children might be influenced by him. Amina tace "insha Allahu zai gyara Principal" daganan tatashi tafita tabar office ɗin.

Tunda Amina tafito a office ɗin principal tafiya kawai takeyi batareda tasan ina zatajeba,tasan Lamiɗo bayason karatu anma bata taɓa tunanin he'll skip classes sabida hakaba,bata taɓa tsanmanin har abun zekai ga batun yaƙi rubuta test ba, gameda batun ƴan mata kuma bazatayi blaming kowa ba sekanta dan dabakinshi yasha zuwa yasameta yace "Umma nayi sabuwar kamu" kokuma yace "Umma naga wata fara Ƴar kyakyawa yau kuma tayimin gobe zanje farauta" kokuma yace "Umma kinyi sabuwar suruka fah" anma bata taɓa ɗaukar maganar tasa da seriousness ba sede tayi dariya tace "Lamiɗo kaikam ba'a rabaka da shirme koh" wani sa'in kuma tace "yaro inzakayi karatu kayi karatu ka ajiye batun Ƴan mata agefe. There's time for everything inlokacin sa yayi sekayi amma bayanzu ba" aduk sanda yaji tayi maganarnan cewa yake "Umma kidai barni inyi lokacinane,akwai sanda za'ace inyima bazanyiba" ashedai duk maganar Ƴan Mata dayakeyi mata dagaske yakeyi?ashedai Lamiɗon ta yafara tsayawa zance batareda tasani ba wanda tanada tabbacin may be yana ɗaya daga cikin abubuwan dake hanashi karatu inda wata zuciyar kuma tashiga raya Mata "kodai dagaske he's under the influence of bad friends ne kamar yanda principal ɗin yafaɗa?" tasandai amsar tambayartannnan daga bakin mutum ɗaya zata sameshi "Hafiz" he's the only friend na Lamiɗo dayake zuwa har gida yagaidata kuma suna zumunci da mahaifiyarsa ma sauran abokanan shi kuwa sede taji labarinsu abakin Lamiɗon amma ai duka sunjima suna tare.

Amina tana isa unguwarsu gidansu Hafiz tama mai machine kwatance yakaita. Tajima agidan suna hira da mahaifiyar Hafiz ɗin harsaida taga shabiyu takusa,su Lamiɗon sunkusa dawowa daga makaranta gashi batayi lunch ba sannan tamata sallama tatafi bayan tabar mata sallahu in Hafiz ya dawo daga makaranta yazo gida tana nemanshi don Allah.

Lamiɗo tunda yadawo daga makaranta yaga canji agurin Ummarsa,she's be acting weirdly kuma babu irin tambayar duniyar nan dabaiyi mataba amma ko cikanka batacemai ba wanda hakan yatabbatarmai dacewa fushin dashi akeyi bada kowaba tunda gashi tana harkokin gabanta da sauran Ƴaƴanta. ba ƙaramin damuwa yashiga ba hakanan abincin da tasa Basma takawomai ɗakin shi ma kinci yayi sabida kwata kwata ji yayi bashida appetite ɗin kuma. Umma naganin yashigo parlourn tayi maza ta tsuke fuskarta. karasawa inda take zaune Lamiɗo yayi yazauna shima sannan yace "Umma I'm sorry" amma ko kallonshi Amina batayiba bare yasa ran zata kulashi,kamar me shirin yin kuka yasa hannu yakamo hannunta yasaka cikin nashi yace "yanzu Umma shiru zakiyitayi bazakicemin komai ba? your silent is hurting me more. gwanda ki dakeni,gwanda kiyimin duka akan laifuffukan danayi than keeping quiet sabida hakan yafi azabtar dani" Umma kwace hannunta tayi still batace masa komaiba.

Umma dai batace masa komai ba Lamiɗo yace "nasan nayi laifi daban bi umarnin ki ba,banyi abunda kikeso ba amma aini bantaba ɓoye miki komaina ba Umma,tunbayau ba kinsan banason karatu,nasha faɗa miki acireni a makaranta anma kinki bin abunda nikeso shiyasa nayi taking wannan step ɗin. batun Ƴan mata kuma da akace inadashi wallahi ƙarya akayimin. niban taba budurwa ba inbanda friendship dake tsakanina dasu, shiɗinma su suka nema, maganar hira da akace inayi dasu inasasu suyi skipping classes niban taɓa cewa watarsu tazo tasameni a Inda nake zamaba suda kansu suka fara bina Umma anma insha Allahu tunda haryakai ga ana zuwa ana tadar miki da hankali bazan sake ba. Kiyi hakuri kiyafe mun don Allah,fushin ki wallahi azabtar dani yakeyi" Umma kallonshi tayi sannan tace "Uhmmm! nidama nace banyafe maka baneba? yana iya dakai daman inbanyi hakuriba tunda kanuna kafi karfina,kafi karfin in faɗa maka kayi,kafi karfin kataimakamin incika ma mahaifinka burinsa nason kazama mutum kamar kowa" Lamiɗo dayagama gane Umma faɗa masa magana takeyi a fakaice yasashi cewa "wallahi Umma bahaka baneba" Umma tace "Hakane mana Lamiɗo. kuma tunda kanuna kafi karfina semu tattara mukoma *Kwami* kawai gaba ɗaya,kannen naka ma dasun kara wayau duk aure zanyi musu tunda konace suyi karatun zasu iya kinyi tunda sunga Yayansu ma bai maida hankali ba sabida haka kafara shiri,kazuba ruwa akasa kasha zakabar karatun Boko kaje kayi abunda ranka yakeso,inkaga dama ma kaje kacigaba da haɗa temple kana tara mata suna zuwa kallon kyawun da Allah yayi maka" daganan Umma tatashi tabarshi zaune gurin kamar wani gunki.

Tunda yake arayuwarsa bai taɓa ganin tayi fushi irin haka ba hakanan bata taɓa furta magana mai zafi irin wannan agaresa ba,akullum albarka take saka masa wanda furucin ta nayau ɗin yasashi gane cewa yakaita bangone,tarasa yanda zatayi dashine shiyasa tayanke wannan decision ɗin. Shi mutum ne meyi mata biyayya akoda yaushe, maikuma son sata farin ciki kullum da ko kannensa ne suka sata yawan magana harhakan yaja bacin ranta he's always the one that cheers her up anma segashi yau for the very first time arayuwarsa shine sanadiyar ɓacin ran nata. damuwarsa ayanzu baiwuce yazaiyi yagyara laifin sa ba,atake wata zuciyar tace "Lamiɗo kayi abunda takeso,kayi mata biyayya wannan shine kaɗai abunda zaisa tasauko daga dokin fushin datakeyi dakai" ayayinda wata zuciyar kuma tashiga raya masa "toh zaka iyan ne? Kaida kaƙi jinin karatun boko tayaya zaka iya cika mata burinta?" and the other part immediately says "Uwace fah. kawai dole hakura zakayi kayi ɗin koda kuwa bakaso,kwana nawane ma yarage kagama karatun baki ɗaya?" dawa dannan tunanin Lamiɗo yayanke shawarar sauke duk wasu makamansa nason kinyi karatu tareda niyar washegari zaigyara halinsa.

Haka ya koma zuwa makaranta as a changed person,yamadaina skipping classes bare har yaje inda yake ɓuya Ƴan Mata da abokanan banza suzo suna tayashi zama. A ranar yaje yasamu malaman da yayi missing test ɗinsu sukayi mishi makeup,damuwarshi ɗaya dukyanda yaso yamaida hankalinshi a aji don yagane abunda akeyi he always end up sleeping kokuma yafaɗa wata duniyar tunani sabida tsabar ranshi bayason abun. Kullum inzai tafi makaranta seyaje yagaishe da Umma anma bazata amsa ba hakan kuma bazai hanashi sake gaisheta ba inya dawo. Lamiɗo yadaina zuwa koda football ɗinda akeyi kullum yanma a unguwarsu ne,ya tsiri tayasu Jidda yin assignment ɗinsu na makaranta dukdan Umma taga canzawarsa anma abanza wannan yasa hankalinsa yayi kololuwar tashi,yashiga damuwa hakanan yadaina cin abinci sosai,duk yabi yarame cikin sati biyu dayayi yana wannan ladabin amma Uwartasa taƙi ko kallon sa bare yayi tunanin samun sassauci daga gareta kwana kusa. Hankalinshi bai kara tashiba seda su Jidda sukazo sunamai kuka kan Umma tace zasu koma *Kwami* dazama karshen watannan kuma tace dasun koma aure zatayi musu dukansu dan Allah yaje yabata hakuri kilan taji tunda shine favorite ɗinta kuma shi ya mata laifin daya jaza musu wannan matsalar.

Adaren ranar Lamiɗo yaje ɗakin Umman nasa yazauna gefenta sekawai yafara kuka,kuka irin me tsuma zuciyarnan datasa zuciyarta karaya lokaci guda. dole tasauke duk wasu makaman yaƙinta cikeda damuwa tashiga tambayarshi dalilin kukan nasa tace "Kaikuma goɗai goɗai dakai kukan mekakeyi Lamiɗo?" yanda tayimasa maganar bazata taɓa cewa fushi takeyi dashiba,she act as if nothing happens(Uwa kenan) wanda hakan yakara bama Lamiɗo kwarin gwiwa hakanan bebar kukan dayakeyiba har lokacin yace "Umma kiyi hakuri kidaina fushi dani don Allah" and she couldn't help it but to hug her only male Son,rungumeta yayi tightly yanata maimaita faɗin "Umma kiyihakuri kidaina fushi dani. Umma kiyi hakuri kidaina fushi dani don Allah. namiki alkawarin bazan sake disappointing ɗinki ba,zanyi abunda kikeso ɗin" cikeda tausayinshi Umma tace "yawuce Lamiɗo. kadaina kukan nan ya'isa haka kada su Jidda suji Yaya babba yana kuka" and for the first time he smiled tun bayan data fara fushi dashi.
yashiga goge hawayensa yana faɗin "ai in suka ga hawayennan duk sesun biyani kayana dan nadinga zugaki mutattara mukoma Kwami kenan" dariya Amina tayi tana mai tayashi goge gunji gunjin hawayensa tace "watodai yarannan karata suka kaiwurinka koh?" yace "A'a Umma bawanda yakawo kararki jinayi kuna maganar" Umma na murmushi tace "yimin shiru sekace bansan halinkuba daga kai harsu ɗin" Lamiɗo yace "toh Umma tunda kinsan halin mu kiyi hakuri kibarmu a birni karki maidamu ƙauye" yakarashe maganar cikin sigar shagwaba Umma tace "duk wannan zancensu ne banaka ba ni nasani. Kai da ko acikin kogo akace kazauna so far as akwai abinci babu abunda zaihana ka zama Lamiɗo" Lamiɗo yace "toh adaiyimana afuwa abarmu anan ɗin Umma" Umma tayi murmushi tana satan kallon kofar ɗakinta dantasan yaran nanan gurin laɓe sunajinsu tace "zanyi maku afuwa amma sekasa kowacce ta ciko maka plate ɗai ɗai da abinci takawomin nayi feeding ɗinka" aikuwa dasauri suka fito daga laɓen dasukayi suna faɗin "Umma zamu kawo wallahi" daganan kuma suka ruga aguje sukayi kitchen daniyar zuwa ɗebo abincin inda suka bar Lamiɗo da Umman nasu namusu dariya.

Basma ce tafara kawo nata sannan Jidda sannan Salma, Lamiɗo na kallonsu duka yace "wato laɓe kukazo kuna mana nida Umma na koh?" Jidda tace "Yaya dolece tasamu yin laɓen nan wallahi" Lamiɗo yace "Aiko seku shirya komawa Kwami tunda dukanku kunga hawayena" Basma dasauri tace "nidai bangani ba Hamma" Salma tace "Nimadai banganiba Hamma" Jidda data rasa yanda zatayi ta kare kanta tace "oh so kuke kuce nikadai nagani kenan komi?" And they all laughed at her reaction.

Lamiɗo yace "uwar tsarguwa kwantar da hankalinki babu mai komawa Kwami dazama sede zuwa hutu" tuni jidda tashiga washare baki tana murna. Lamiɗo yamaida kallonsa kan plates har uku da duka ke makare da abinci yace "nashigesu inazankai duka wannan abincin?" Umma tace "duka meals ɗinka dakayita missing suka haɗo maka anan duk seka cinyesu yau" pity face Lamiɗo yayi yace "Umma Allah yamin yawa sede inci ɗaya yanzu, ɗaya anjima, ɗaya gobe" dariya Umma tayi sannan tadubi Basma tace "Basma tashi kiɗauko tray mujuye duka muci abincin tare" dasauri Basma tafice a ɗakin Lamiɗo nafaɗin "Daman nayi kewar cin abinci tareda ku wallahi".

Bayan sungama cin abincin ma seda yataimaka musu sukayi assignments ɗinsu sannan suka danyi kallo kafin kowa yatafi makwancisa daga baya. 

Tundaga nan Lamiɗo yake kokari gurin ganin baisake ɓata ma Ummarsa raiba,daman akan karatune kuma yadaina laifuffukan daduk akace yanayi a daɗin. Karatunne dai haryau bayason sa kuma baya tunanin zai taɓa sonsa arayuwarsa,yanayine kawai don ya faranta ma Umman nasa rai dukda kuwa bayamaida hankali yagane ɗin,yanadai copying note da dictation in malami nayi sabida shine kaɗai Savior ɗinshi dankuwa inzasuyi test aranar dazasuyin yake ɗaukan note ɗinshi yakaranta yashiga yayi test ɗin, inkuma exams ne se ana gobe za'ayi exams ɗin ze ɗauki littafinsa ya kakkaranta yaje yarubuta and luckily he always pass with average scores ahaka yasamu yagama secondary school ɗin. Sanda Umma tamai maganar jamb kuwa baitada hankalin shiba dan ya ɗauka jami'ar ma kamar secondary school ne,zaiyi mata yanda yakeyi a secondary school ayi awuce gun kawai anma seyaga abun yasha banban da yanda yake tunani daya samu admission,yayi registration ya fara zuwa lectures. Lecture se ayini anayi,dawannan malamin yafita wani zai shiga hakanan kowanne yazo ze dibga musu uban handout yakuma ce sukaranta unlike secondary school dabai wuce amusu dictation ɗin pages huɗu ba arana na gaba ɗaya courses ɗin. tun Lamiɗo naganin abun kamar wasane daga baya zasu samu sauki anma sema abunda yayi gaba wanda hakan yasa yafara gajiya,yaji bazai iya jurewa ba. Seyaje wannan lecture ɗin yaƙi zuwa next one hakadai,daga bayama yazo yadaina zuwa sosai,seyayi kwana biyu bai shiga ajiba sede dayashigo makaranta yawuce hostel ɗakin wani abokin shi dake zaman hostel ya sharara barcinsa in lokacin tashi yayi yatafi gida abunsa har akazo aka fara continues assessment wanda se alokacin yaje yasayi handouts ɗinda akayita jibga musu. In za'ayi test se ranar daza'ayi zaikaranta kuma baya taɓa iya gama karantawan sabida yawanshi ba iri ɗaya bane dana secondary school anma ahakan zeshiga rubuta test ɗin with the hope za'ayi tambaya a Inda ya karan ta ɗin anma seyaga abunfa bahaka baneba. haka yayi tayi har aka gama test aka fara kawo scripts duk seyaga yayi failing gashi lokacin exams yariga yazo babu lokacin yin karatu na haikan mani'in kuma ko akwai ma Lamiɗo baya tunanin zai iya,na secondary school da da yake kaɗan ma kawai kuke zuciyar sa yakeyi yayi ahaka barekuma yanzu da abun yafi karfin tunaninsa dole ahaka yarubuta exams ɗin sukayi hutu.

Da akadawo kuwa aka manna result segashi a probation. hankalinshi ya matukar tashi alokacin bawaidan damuwarshi Umma anma ahaka dole yaje yafada mata halin da ake ciki anma sebata masa faɗa ba tace yadage kawai next time dan daman tunda yasamu admission ɗin Hajiya Hadiza tacemata course ɗin nada wahala kuma ana faɗi sosai shiyasa koda yayi failing tayi masa uzuri,bata taɓa kawowa ranta Lamiɗo yakoma gidan jiya baneba tunda tana ganin effort ɗinshi akullum,yana zuwa makaranta,yana kuma tsayawa karatu har dare. wannan rashin damuwar da Umma tanuna yasa second semester ɗinma yacigaba dayin abunda yakeyi,acewarsa tunda Ummarsa ma tasan makarantar da wahala zata cigaba dayi masa uzuri harzuwa lokacin dataga yakasa ta haƙura tacireshi.

Suna gama session ɗin farko da result yafito yaga anyi masa step down bewani damuba sabida yasan Umma zata sake yimasa uzuri,ahaka aka dawo next session wanda alokacin yama dena attending lectures kwata kwata,sede yashigo yagama yawonsa in lokacin komawa gida yayi yakoma gida,haka in lokacin Test da exams yagabato seyace ma Umma kwana zaiyi a school yayi karatu and she'll allow him wanda inyazo ɗin bewuce yayita yawace yawace da friends ba sekuma duk inda dare yayi yaje hostel yakwana wataran kuma yagudo gida ya tsallako ta katanga yashige ɗakinsa ta window yayi baccinshi peacefully,assusuba nayi kuma zai sake ficewa batare da kowa ya sani ba yakoma makaranta wanda ananne zeshiga neman gurayen ajinsu yaroƙi alfarmar su shiga jarabawar tare dan ya zauna a bayansu su goyashi,inkuma baisamu ba haka zai rubuta paper yafito abunsa with the believe cewa definitely cewa course ɗin zata dawo masa.

Atakaice dai Lamiɗo saubiyu yayi 100 level,200level ma haka wanda seda yazo sakeyin na biyun ne suka haɗu dasu Auwal suka kulla abokantaka ta dalilin Hafiz dashi daman baisamu admission dawuri ba sabida failing jamb dayayi tayi abaya. haɗuwa dasune yasa perception ɗinsa na akore a makarantar yafara canzawa,yaji shima bayason asake barin shi abaya yanason gamawa tareda su yahuta da wahalar bokon tunda haryau Umman ma batada niyar cewa yahakura da karatun. Inda kuma Allah yataimakeshi Ƴan clique ɗin su Hafiz ɗin duk sunada ƙoƙari,basu kuma da baƙin hali sesuke goyashi subashi amsa a hall yayi passing kamar su.

Bangaren Umma kuwa dukda shekarun da Lamiɗo ya ɓata a makaranta yana fama bata taɓa nuna masa damuwarta ba dukda kuwa abun na matukar damunta arai,seeing his efforts, perseverance and dedication yasa takeyi mishi uzuri akullum,she fully believe cewa Lamiɗo yana karatun haikan mani'an tunda yana nuna efforts ɗinsa a fili shiyasa kawai takeyi mishi addu'a kawai,akullum yama ta korafin wahalar jami'a setayi ta encouraging ɗinshi dacewa wataran zaizama labari in Allah yayarda shikuma Lamiɗo tsoron ya ɓata matarai tayi fushi dashi irinna da yasa yakeyi mata wannan karyayyakin batareda tasaniba. Umma a gabadaya rayuwarta flaws biyu tasani a tattare da Lamiɗo wanda takeda yakinin ta magance ɗaya ayanzu saura ɗaya. ma'ana ta magance matsalar rashin son karatun sa saura taurin kansa dakuma rashin hakurin sa akan abunda yakeso. Lamiɗo inyana son abu he always go for it,he can take any risk for what his heart desires,babu ruwanshi da consequences ɗinda ke cikin abunda yakeso ɗin,babu ruwanshi da abunda mutane zasu ce,hakanan baya hana kanshi abunda yakeso wai don yana tsoron wani. Lamiɗo bayabin abu a saru saru,baya neman shawarar kowa inyana son abu he just go for it,a believe ɗinshi babu wanda zai iya yimashi abu inba shiba,a believe ɗinshi if you want something now just give it your efforts and get it right instant without thinking about the negativity. yakanyi mamaki inyaga mutane na haƙurar ma zuciyarsu abunda takeso sabida maganar mutane, sabida consequences ɗinda ke cikin samun abun,sabida negativity ɗinda ke cikin samun abun,sabida risk ɗin dake cikin samun abun but to him waɗannan duk baswa cikin agender ɗinshi. Indai yanason abu bayama tunanin wasu risk da consequences sema achievement ɗinda zaisamu indai ya mallaki wannan abun hakanan indai yaƙi abu toh yakishine. His only weakness is his love for his Mother shiyass yake mata karya akan abubuwa guda biyu,akan karatu dakuma *Maimunatu*. His only girl friend,yarinyar da'ita kaɗai ce taciri tuta cikin Mata dukda kuwa irin crushing dinda Yan mata masu aji,kudi dasauransu keyi akasa,ita kadai yagani yaji tayimasa. Kawar Basma ce,ajinsu daya a Islamiya kuma tana yawan zuwa gidansu gurin Basma wanda ananne yaganta,shi babu abunda yaburgeshi a ita irin kamun kanta dakuma zakin muryarta,mata da dama suka kalleshi susake kallo amma banda Maimunatu wanda tunranar farko dayaganta agidansu yaji taburgeshi,bugu da Kari yazo yaji zakin muryarta topha daganan yadaura aniyar seyayi dating dinta amma bazai taba bari Basma tasaniba sabida yasan gulmarta da iyawarta, bakaramin aikinta bane tafada ma Ummansu Kuma shi bayason Umma tasani tunbayan incident dincan dakuma lura dayayi bataso yanayi mata hirar budurwa,tafison seyagama karatu shiyasa yabi tahanyaar Yar hannun damansa Jidda,ita tayi connecting dinsu in no time suka fara soyayya suke Kuma exchanging letters batareda kowa yasaniba.

*CIGABAN LABARI* 

Umma,Basma,jidda da Salma dake kwance kan cinyar Umma tana ta zuba mata shagwaɓa sukajiyo sallamar Hafiz da Lamiɗo daga bakin kofar parlournsu. Umma ce ta amsa sallamar tana mamakin miye dalilin dawowan Lamiɗon gida dawuri haka yau dan a iya saninta indai ba lokacin makaranta ba ana hutu yakan kai goma zuwa sha ɗaya na dare baidawo gidaba. karasowa cikin parlourn Lamiɗo da Hafiz sukayi inda Hafiz yasamu guri yazauna yana gaishe da Umman.

Umma amasawa tayi tana tambayarshi lafiyan Ummanshi,yace "tananan lafiyanta kalau" Umma tace "toh madallah. yaudai ansamu angama jarabawa" Hafiz yace "Eh wlhy Umma. Sekuma aji hudu dayardar Allah" Umma na murmushi tace "Allah yabaku sa'a toh" wannan karan dukansu suka amsa da "Amin" Lamiɗo datunda yashigo yazo yazauna gefenta yace "Umma zuwa nayi naɗauko maki Hafiz tundaga majalisa sabida yamiki clerifying cewa Ƴar birni ba aljana baceba.

Umma da mamakinshi tace "Wai daman bamu gama maganarnan bane Lamiɗo?" sosa kai Lamiɗo yashigayi yana murmushi yace "toh yazanyi Umma. kinki yarda dani shiyasa" Hafiz dake gefe yana murmushi shima yace "Umma ba aljana baceba,kauyen da muke saukan ma garin iyayen kakartane taje yimasu hutu lokacin anma itada mahaifinta cikin garin Bauchi suke zama. mutanen garin nada mutunci wallahi,sanda ciwon kafar Lamiɗo yatashi ma agurinsu yayita zama suna bashi abinci Inmun dawo muɗaukeshi mukoma cikin gari" cikeda mamaki Umma tadubi Lamiɗo tace "ciwon kafarka yatashi acanne dama?" Lamiɗo yace "Eh Umma amma tun washegarin ranar ya warke" Umma tace "dukda hakadai daka faɗamin. gaskiya zamu koma wurin Mallam Buzu yasake baka wancan maganin tunda dakasha shekarun baya dasuka wuce tunda yanzu ciwon yana yawan tashi akai akai bakamar sanda aka baka maganiba,ai wancan lokacin yajima ciwon kafar bata tashiba" Lamiɗo dayagama gajiya da maganar ciwon kafar yafison ayi na tafiyanshi Babban buli yace "Umma naji saukifah basai munjeba,yanzudai maganar zuwa Babban bulin please! tunda Hafiz ya tabbatar miki ba aljana bace kibarni inje don Allah" Umma ta ɓata rai tace "bawani kunje kun haɗa baki awaje dai zakazo kanamin zakin baki" Hafiz dariya yayi sannan yace "bahaka baneba Umma. Allah duk abunda nafaɗa dagaske ne. mutum ce kamarmu" Umma tace "kai nayarda dakai Hafiz shidinnedai nakeson ganin karshen naci yau" Lamiɗo najin haka yayi sauri ya marairaice fuska sannan yace "Umma ba naci bane wallahi. alfarma nike nema kuma tunda kinyarda mutum ce kamar mu ki amince min inje goben Please" Umma ta hararanshi tayi tareda duban Hafiz tace "kaji nacin nashi koh?" Hafiz dai dariya yayi baice komaiba.

Lamiɗo yasake marairaice fuska yace "pleaseee Ummana. Agoben fa zandawo insha Allahu" Umma tace "sede in tareda Hafiz ɗin zakuje" dantasan halin Lamiɗo indai batabarshi yajeba yadinga mata jaraba kenan.

Lamiɗo jin abunda Umman tace cikin sauri cikeda murna yace "Zerakani Umma. Allah zamuje tare" Umma tace "katambayi ra'ayinshi ne dazakayi concluding" pity face Lamiɗo yayi yana duban Hafiz yace "Ina zaka rakani?" dariya Hafiz yayi kafin yagyada masakai ahankali.

Lamiɗo yamaida dubanshi kan Umma yace "kinji yace zairakani Koh? toh mushirya goben mutafi kenan?" Umma tace "banceba ni. banida kuɗi tukunnan kubari zuwa jibi in ankawomin kuɗin ɗinki se inbaku kujeku" Lamiɗo beso hakaba amma dayake yasan Umman batada shi ɗinne tunda har tafaɗi haka yasashi rungume ta yana murmushi tareda faɗin "Thank you Ummana. Wajajen ƙarfe ɗaya motarsu Lamiɗo tasauka abakin tashar Bauchi. Lamiɗo nafitowa daga motar yatari napep yace da mai napep ɗin yakaishi general hospital. Take zuciyarshi tabashi amsar "kaje katambayi Nurses ɗin ward ɗin mana" dawnnan tunanin yaɗaga kafa daniyar juyawa yafita yabar ɗakin anma seyaga daga patient har masu zama da patient ɗin ɗakin sun zubamai idanu suna mamakin tsayuwar dayayi kansa yana tunanin duniya shikadai bece musu komai ba. Lamiɗo gaba-daya ma hankalinsa baya jikinsa. duniyar tunani yashiga,duniyar da takunshi Rukayya da Umma kawai. 99%na zuciyar nason zama yaga Rukayya anma inya tuna tahowar dayayi yau daga Gombe babu ko sallama,dakuma abunda yashuka kafin yataho ɗin seyaji gaba ɗaya hankalinsa ya dungunzuma yakoma Gomben baki ɗaya. Murmushi Lamiɗo yayi sannan yama Buban godiya kafin yaje yashige motar. Shikanshi besan wani irin shakuwa sukayi da Rukayya ba dahar yakeyi mata irin wannan tausayin. gaba ɗaya yadamu yasan halinda takeciki anma tayaya? tunda dolenshi yakoma Gombe yau.

Inanan zaune main parlour har akafara kiraye kirayen sallar maghriba bansake ganin wulgawan kowaba wanda hakan ba ƙaramin mamaki yabani ba. anma kuma danayi la'akari da irin son kallon yaran gidan se banyi mamaki sosaiba,senayi tunanin duka yaran suna kofar iyayen su suna kallo ne ayayinda mazan kuma sukecan boys quarters. Sekuma natuna da ganin Safiya dabanyi a parlourn Aunty ba. Sannan Itama Aunty haryanzu banyi katari da'ita ba.

Take Kuma wata zuciyar tashiga rayamin kilan Safiya da Auntyn suna cikin ɗakin Aunty ne shiyasa bangansuba.

Yaya Salim kuwa banyi mamakin rashin ganin sanda yafita ba tunda akwai times ɗinda nayi spending adakin su Yaya Siyama and may be awannan lokacin ne yafice agidan dankuwa nasan babu yanda za'ayi yayita zama acikin gida harwannan lokacin bare kuma danasan shi mutum ne meshegen son tsilla tsilla. Baya zama guri ɗaya. Sedanaji ana kokarin tada sallah awani masallaci sannan natashi daniyar yin alwala inyi tawa sallar nima. Harna nufi hanyar ɗakin su Yaya Siyama sena tuna kashedin data yimin ɗazu danhaka sena fasa zuwa ɗakin nasu nabi hanyar backdoor ɗinda naga tabi ɗazu tareda tunanin may be akwai famfo acan se inyi alwalan nawa kawai.

Ina fita backdoor ɗin hango Yaya Siyama nayi zaune gaban murhun da'aka hura a bakin kitchen ɗinsu tana ta aikin rabon tuwo. Ɗauke kaina nayi daga kallonta sannan nafara duben duben surrounding ɗin gurin kozan hangi tap and then I saw a building dayayimin kama da bandaki dankuwa saman building ɗinma babu roof kwata kwata but it seems completed. Karasawa nayi wurin building ɗin sannan nasa hannu na buɗe kofar inda naga ashe bandakin ne kamar yanda nayi tsanmani.

Ciki nashiga nakama ruwa sannan nayi alwala nakoma main parlour nayi sallah na.

Inanan zaune Yaya Siyama tazo tayita zirga zirgan shigowa da kulolin abinci tana kaiwa kowa nasu kofarsu harta gama tazo tawuce ɗakinsu.

Wuraren karfe tara da rabi na dare sega Yaya Salim yashigo. dayake parlourn akwai haske sosai shiyasa yana shigowa yaganni.

Fuska ɗaukeda murmushi yace "Aaaah Rukayya kece anan?" Murmushin yaƙe nasaki sannan nace "eh" Yaya Salim yace "toh taho muje Abba nakiranki. Abunda yashigo dani kenan daman" yakarashe maganar ayayinda yajuya yanufi kofar fita a parlourn cikin sauri natashi nabi bayanshi nima.

Sashin dabaikai na matan gidan girmaba muka nufa. A parlour muka samu Kawu idrissan,yanazaune kan carpet yana kallon *Aljazeera* idanunshi sanye da Medicated glasses ayayinda trayn abinci ke ajiye gefenshi, plate da serving spoon ɗin duk uncleaned dasu da alamadai yanzu yagama cin dinner ɗinsa.

Sallama Yaya Salim yayi wanda hakan yasa attention ɗin Kawu Sanin yadawo garemu. Fuska sake yake kallona sannan yace "Rukayya" ahankali nace "Na'am?" alama yamin da hannu inzo ni. Gyaɗa mai kai nayi ahankali sannan na ƙarasa inda yake zaune inashirin zama agabanshi yayi sauri yakama hannuna na ƙarasa gefenshi sannan yamin nuni da inzauna agefenshi. zama nayi sannan ya ɗaura hannunsa kaina yana shafawa yace "how are you doing?" Ahankali nace "fine" atakaice.

Kace inzamuyi gasar bazanyi dawasaba. Dole Sena shirya" sekuma suka saki dariya atare wanda hakan yasani sakin murmushin dole nima. adede lokacin kuma Yaya Fahad yashigo parlourn kanshi sauke akasa.

Karasowa yayi yazauna gefen Yaya Salim sannan yashiga gaida Kawu idrissa.

Yace "Ina wuni Abba?" Kawu idrissa yace "lafiya Lau Son. Ya kokari?" Yaya Fahad yace "alhamdulillah" Kawu idrissa yace "toh Masha Allah" sannan yakarada "kaje kadauko mahaifiyar taka daga gidan Innan ne?" Gyaɗa kai Yaya Fahad yayi sannan yace "Eh Abba. Muna hanyar dawowa ne ma Salim yakirani yace kana nemana" Kawu idrissa yace "auuu aina ɗauka cemasa kayi zaka tafi daukotane lokacin ashe harkuna hanyar dawowa ma lokacin" wannan karan gyaɗa kai kawai Yaya Fahad yayi.
Sauke ajiyar zuciya Kawu Sani yayi still yana kallon Yaya Fahad ɗin sannan yace "Wai kunje gidan uncle's ɗinku dazu da Rukayya Koh?" Ɗagowa Yaya Fahad yayi ya kalli Kawu Sani Sannan yace "Eh Abba" Kawu Sani yace "Salim has told me everything kuma nayita kiran shi kawun naku inji daga gareshi anma haryanzu baya daga wayana. Besides,danan dacan ɗin duk dayane ai,inma kuma daga baya yazo yace zaidauketan duk ba matsala baneba" jinjinakai Yaya Fahad da Yaya Salim sukayi atare.

Ni abun ma dariya yaso yabani amma sena ɓoye kayana acikina. Dayake inada nauyin jiki kuma wanke wanken nada yawa yasa bangama dawuri ba har se wuraren sha biyun rana wanda alokacin ne kuma Yaya Siyama tafito yin girkin rana dole tasani nasaka mata hannu muka fara aikin tare.

Satin mu ɗaya da dawowa Kawu Sani yadawo daga Abuja,cikin yaran inaga Mariya da sule ne kaɗai ke farin ciki dankuwa gaba daya sauran a tsorace suke,tararradin abunda Kawu Sanin zaiyi musu idan yasamu labarin abunda sukayimin sukeyi. Aunty ma batasanar dashi komai ba dukda kuwa ranar girkinta ne yadawo, inaga tayi hakan ne sabida ganin irin gajiyar daya debo ahanya ne dankuwa na tabbatar data sanar dashi aranar zaiyi addressing ɗin abin anma from yanda yaketa sakarmana murmushi damukaje yimashi sannu dazuwa dakuma yanda ya amsa gaisuwar mu faran faran washegari dasafe daya shigo sashin namu kaɗai zaisanar dakai baisamu labarin ba tukunnan. Adaren washegarin ne nida Sadiya muna parlourn Aunty muna kallo ayayinda Yaya Siyama da Yaya Safiya ke ɗaki sega Auntyn tashigo wai Kawu Sani yana kiranmu duka,yace kowa yaje da result ɗinshi.

Cewa mukayi "toh" ayayinda nafita a parlourn don in ɗauko nawa inda Sadiya kuma tashige ɗaki donta ɗauki nata takuma sanar dasu Yaya Safiya sakon Kawu Sanin. Congratulations and keep it up" Ina murmushi nace "Thank you" sakina yayi daga jikinshi sannan yace "Oyajeki dauko gifts din ingani kafin nima inzo inbaki nawa kyautar" gyadamasakai nayi sannan nafita a parlourn cikin sauri inata murmushi dankuwa dukyanda naso kar inyi farin cikin kasawa nayi yanzu kuma.

Nasandai ba Yaya Zunnurain baneba tunda shi sanda baswanan ma inakawo Masa abinci nakanzo indauki empty foodflask ma. Atsakanin Yaya Fahad da Yaya Salim ne to which I don't know wanene acikinsu. Tunranar da Kawu Sani yasanar dani zanje Babban buli hutu a weekend nashiga irgen kwanaki,kamar yau in gari ya waye se ince saura kwana kaza inje Babban buli! Washegari karfe takwas Yaya Zunnurain yadebemu a mota yayi Babban buli damu dankuwa Kawu Sani cewa yayi shizaikaimu dukda dafari Yaya Salim yaso kaimu dakanshi. Yace Kuma kaima yinin zakayi,kaje kaga kauye,kaga mutanen cikinsu,kaga yanayin yanda suke rayuwa dadai sauransu banason kudawo gidannan se shidan yanma tayi.

Yaya Salim dariyar mugunta yadinga musu kasa kasa alokacin ayayinda yakebi ɗaya bayan ɗaya yanayi musu Allah yakara. Se kunkuni suke kamar zasu shakeshi. Sanda muka Isa Babban buli zokuga murna,da gudu nashiga gida na rungume Gogode Ina ihun farin ciki inda sedaga baya su Buba suka biyoni dakayana dakuma bakin Dana manta da kashin su awaje tsabar zumudi. Hakuri nabasu ayayinda Gogode dakanta tadauko musu katuwar tabar ma tashimfida musu akarkashin runfarta tace suzauna. Tarba babu irin wanda basu gani ba ranar. Haka aka ciga gabansu da dammammar fresh fura da nono dakuma hadaddiyar Dambun daba'a Jima dasaukeshi daga kan wuta ba. Yaya Zunnurain kuwa tuni Buba yajashi suka fita can gidanshi Wai dagacan inyasha nashi fura da nonon sesu wuce yawo......

Bakaramin daɗin yanda basuyi kyamar su Gogode dakuma nuna musu dabasuyuba nayi dankuwa sundan saki jikinsu, Sunsha fura da nonon da aka kawo musu. Allah yasadai yadawo din" "Amin" suka amsa minda duka.

Sebayan azahar sannan nakoma gida inda anan nasamu anyi masu Yaya Zaheera lafiyayyar kunun hatsi da biski miyar taushe,basuwani ci sosai ba dayake bazaka taba hada taste din abincin birni dana kauyeba dukda kuwa su ahakan sunyi musu iya kurewar medadi kenan. Seyanma lilis suka tafi bayan ancikasu da kayan arziki akace sukai gida,kana daga kan kalwa ne,kukane,tsintsiyane har fura da nono. Bayan tafiyarsu dadarene Sena samu Gogode nayi Mata maganar Lamido inda ananne take sake jaddaddamin yazoshi Kuma yace nace Masa zanzo hutu inda sukuma sukace Masa Basu sani ba kozanzo kobazan zo ba tunda basu hadu daniba dukdama they were planning to go and see me.

Akagare "Toh Gogode bece zedawo baneba?" Girgiza min Kai Gogode tayi sannan tace "Gaskiya baifadamin ba" Sena tura baki gaba kamar me shirin yin kuka ayayinda araina nake addu'ar Allah dai yasa yadawo kafin wani sati inkoma Bauchi. Haka nacigaba da hutu agarin Babban buli cikeda Jin dadi da nashadi,Babu takura,Babu tsangwama kowa Sona yakeyi Yana Kuma yin nannan Dani. Daga muje surge dasafe,wataran muje kiwo,wataran muje diban Karan daza'ayi girki sekuma muje dandali wasa da dare inda dana dawo Kuma zanzo intarar da tsarabana da ake kawomin daga cikin gari kullum, either tsire da bread,ko doya da kwai,ko awara,ko kilishi kokuma wani Kaya makulashe dai haka. Kullum dai shine aikin. Adan kwananin Nan Sena gane cewa living a life of luxury bashine kadai happiness ba,the people around you,how they treat you and how comfortable you're with them shine farin ciki,shine kuma Jin dadin rayuwa. Yau asabar Kuma gabadaya yau very moody natashi dankuwa gobe zankoma Bauchi gashi haryau Kuma Lamido besake zuwa ba wanda hakan yasa nakejin kamar bazan samu ganinsa ba har in koma gobe din.

Acikin shakaru biyunnan abubuwa da dama sun faru acikin tarihin rayuwata wanda bana tunanin akwai Wanda Zan iya mantawa dasu aciki,I went through alot kamar yanda nakeyi tun farkon rayuwata agidan Kawu Sani,infact hardships din akullum karuwa sukeyi anma hakan baitaba hanani gode ma ubangiji na ba because no matter how the circumstances are I'm still blessed,i'm blessed educationally and I'm blessed with so many loved once da in Ina tareda su Koda na awa gudane suna fadin away bad chapters na rayuwana. Baiyi aureba haryanzu Kuma shikadai yake living rayuwar sa a Tantamemen gidansa dake Nan cikin garin abujan dankuwa su Sadiya suntaba zuwa sunsauka agidan sa dasuka je bikin wata cousin dinsu tareda aunty wnda bayan dawowarsu ne naji sunata Wasa kyawun gidan dakuma gulmar Aunty da danginta sunfara yimasa fadar ya fidda mata yayi aure hakanan shekaru se tafiya sukeyi. Adaren ranar tunma kafin inje insamo Yaya Fahad segashi yazo dakanshi gurina,anan varendern kitchen mukayi karatu,seda yatabbatar yazauna sosai a kwakwalwana sannan yace inbiyo muje indauko kulolin abinci da aka Kai musu na dare.

Amma sede fatana ma tunkan inshige gida yatafi abanza dankuwa inaji yatada motar sukabar gidan. wasu hawaye naji sun zubomin a kuncina dana tuna cewa islamiyar da nisa babu yanda za'ayi inje da kafa gashi Kuma banida kudin napep tunda ni ba ma'abociyar dawowa da kudi gida bane hutu. sena cirema raina ma zuwa islamiyar gabadaya ranar,aikuwa Ina shiga gidan ma aka sake jaddaddamin bazanje dinba. Ina cire kayana mukahau yin aiki tukuru da Yaya Zaheera dankuwa ita bataje islamiyar ba,tuni tayi sauka bayan graduation dinta. Su Yaya Aisha ba kwanannan dasun Gama secondary school bada jimawa ba zasuyi nasu saukar shiyasa yaudin ma basuyi fashin zuwaba kasancewar baswason abarsu abaya sujazama kansu Kara shekara daya. Se bayan azahar abadan muka gama kammala komai,acan parlourn baki dake hade da sashin Kawu Sani muka jera komai kafin sukayi dakinsu dasu Yaya Aisha dankuwa suma dasuka dawo daga islamiyar sunzo sunjona mu munyi aikin tare.
