Kawu Sani yadubi Yaya Salim yace "kakaisu sashin ku su huta Koh?" cikin sauri Yaya Lamido yace "a'a mu yanzu zamu koma ma insha Allah" Kawu Sani yace "dawurwuri haka?" Wannan Karan Auwal ne yace "muna gudun kada muyi dare a hanyane" Kawu Sani yace "hakane Kam. Toh Allah ubangiji yamaida ku lafiya" dukansu suka amsa da "Amin" seya ciro kudi a aljihunsa ya ajiye yamika ma Auwal wai suyi kudin mota anma fir suka ki karba,daga karshe Kawu Sani dayaga dagaske suke bazasu karba ba sekawai ya ajiyewa kudin agabansu yana fadin "gashi inbaku dauke ni amatsayin Ubaba Kuma seku barshi agurin" Aida sauri Auwal yasa hannu yadauki kudin sannan suka shiga yima Kawu Sanin godiya shida Yaya lamido. Kawu Sani yace "bakomai ai anzama daya insha Allah" daganan yajuya yadubi Yaya Salim yace "kakaisu tasha Salim" Yaya Salim dangabadaya nakasa gane expression din fuskarsa yace "toh Abba".

Tare muka fita a parlourn bakidaya ayayinda Kawu Sani yayi shigewarsa daki. a car park din gidan muka tsaya gaban motar Yaya Salim ayayinda yacema su Yaya Lamido bariya shiga ciki yadauko car keys dinsa. yana barin gurin Yaya Lamido yajuyo yakalleni cikin sigar zolaya yace "Ashe Nananaa nada kunya" hararanshi nayi playfully sannan nace "bankai kaba ai,kaga yanda kaketa wani sussune kai kuwa" wannan Karan harda Yaya Auwal dake gefe Yana jinmu seda yayi dariya,yace "Ainima Mutumina yau ya kureni. I never thought ya iya ladabi irin wanda yayi yau" dundu Lamido yakaima Auwal yana dariyar shima yace "banason iskanci,katafi kabani gurima ni inason inyi magana da Matata" Yaya Auwal yace "Wace matartaka?" Yaya Lamido yace "shafaaa kaji" Yaya Auwal yayi dariya yace "tun ba'a baka ba kana wannan zumudin?" Yaya Lamido yace "meya rage? tunda Kawunta yafurta ai angama komai insha Allah" Yaya Auwal yace "bawani,Mutumina yanzuma fah aka fara. Za'ayi tambaya,ga sadaki,ga lefe akuma zo ayi maganar biki. aikaifa da hutawa daga yanzu se anshafa fatiha insha Allahu" Auwal yayi maganar yana kallon Lamido kerere irin baimasan wahalar da akesha inza ayi aureba.

Yaya Lamido yace "insha Allah everything will be fine. Tunda aka bani Nanana ai anyi mai wuyar" Yaya Auwal kallona yayi,cikin sigar zolaya yace "karki yarda Rukayya,give him a hard time. Kice shi zaiyi ankon duka friends dinku Kuma kowa na dubu goma za'ayi Mata" dariya nayi sannan cikin sigar zolayar Nima nace "karka damu Yaya Auwal,duka Yan set dinmu duk sesunyi both na Boko dana islamiya" Yaya Auwal na dariya yace "Yauwa Yar gari" Yaya Lamido yace "se Kuma inbaku mamaki inyi musuba" dariya muka saki duka harda Yaya Lamidon dankuwa shikanshi dayafadin abun yasan it's impossible ayanzukam.

Dakyar ya tsagaita dariyarsa yadubi Yaya Auwal yace "Waikai dagaske bazaka bamu guri muyi magana ba?" Yaya Auwal na dariya yace "aifah kuyi hakuri da hirar soyayyarnan yau sekuma wani jikon danwallahi ko canza gun tsuyuwa kukayi binku zanyi" hararanshi Yaya Lamido yayi yana fadin "zanyi maganinka ne" shidai Auwal se dariya yakeyi Mana. Lokaci guda kuma natuna da wayar Yaya Lamido cikin sauri nadubeshi nace "Ina zuwa Yaya lamido" cikin sauri yace "where are you going?" ahankali nace "wayarka zandauko maka" Yaya Lamido yace "wace waya Kuma?" Nace "bakace kasayamin karama ba?" cikin sauri yace "nibancemiki nasaya miki karamar wayaba,cemiki nayi nasaya miki simcard" tura bakinayi nace "but you need the phone" dago karamar Nokia dinda yake rike da'ita yayi sannan yace "I've this kekirike wancan" cikin sauri nace "aiwannan bata browsing nasan kaikuma zaka bukaci kayi" Yaya Lamido yace "karki damu kede Banace ki ajiyeba" pouting bakina nakumayi nace "toh aini ba browsing znyi ba miyasa toh bazaka karbetaba?" Yaya Lamido yace "because I've other plan for us,harna fara Tara kudin sayan nawa" batarai nayi bace "anma Aina gurina ma nakane" batarai Yaya Lamido yayi yace "you're stubborn Nanaa,nagurinki yazama naki" stubbornly nace "a'a kakarbeta kabama Yaya Basma inyaso Inka sayi sabo sekaban karamar na gurinka. Allah Ni bbu abunda zanyi da wayar inbakai damuke magana Daba" Yaya Lamido dafe kai yayi cikeda mamakin stubbornness Dina yace "Basma tanada waya,just recently nasaya Mata Android phone" nace "toh kabama Yaya Jiddah" Yaya Lamido yace "Umma bazata bari tarike waya yanzuba. Seta shiga jami'a" nace "nima ai Umma taji kabani waya fada zatayi" cikin sauri Yaya Lamido yace "aibatama saniba kuma bazama tasani ba and moreover abunda yasa nabaki kenasan danikadai Zaki dinga communicating so kibar maganar nan please Nanaa. Simcard dinakuma tunda ankusa resuming Zan karba inmun koma makaranta insha Allah" nayi niyar sake yimasa musu anma ganin Yaya Salim nataho senayi shiru. Seda yacanza Kafin yafito,karasowa yayi yanabama su Yaya Lamido hakuri kan yatsaya canza kayane ayayinda yashiga kokarin bude drivers seat batareda yadubeniba.

Dede lokacin Yaya Fahad yakaraso gurin hannunsa daya na rataye da jakar system dinsa.

Kokarin bude motarsa dake gefen na Yaya Salim yashigayi wanda hakan yajanyo attention din Yaya Salim,kallon Yaya Fahad din yayi da mamaki sannan yace "Ha'aa Yaya fita zakayine?" Yaya Fahad da alokacin harya saka jakar system dinsa agidan baya ya rufe kofar yace "Yeah" cikeda Curiosity Yaya Salim yace "Ina zakaje?" Yaya Fahad yace "Abuja" sakan baki Yaya Salim yayi yana kallon Yaya Fahad din sannan yace "Abuja fah kace Yaya? kasan time kuwa" yayi maganar ayayinda yabar inda motarsa take yanufi Yaya Fahad din Amma tuni Yaya Fahad yajuya yanufi sashin Kawu Sani yana fadin "A Kano zankwana gobe dasafe zankarasa Abuja insha Allah" Yaya Salim yace "but why are you leaving so soon Yaya?" Ko juyowa Yaya Fahad din beyi ba bare yasa ranzai amsa Masa Wanda hakan yasashi dawowa yashige gaban motar inda su Yaya Lamidon ma suka shiga mukayi sallama suka bar haraban gidan. Seda motarsu ta kulemin dagani sannan nakoma cikin gida.

Zaheera seda ta tabbatar Rukayya tabar gurin sannan tafito daga buyan datayi abayan motar Kawu Sani tundazu,tunda takoma tasanar dasu Ummi cewa tabbas Lamidone yazo neman auren Rukayya Ummin tacemata tadawo taji yazasu Kare dankuwa tasan Kawu Sani bazai taba fada Mata daga bayaba,Salim ma Kuma balallai yabata full detail dinda takeso ba. Koda Zaheeran tadawo eardroping tadingayi harsu Kawu Sanin suka gama magana, dataji zasu fita shine tayi sauri tatafi car park tabuya and luckily for her taji abunda important news dinda suna zaune da Rukayyan for kwanaki basutaba saniba.

Rike haba tayi tana mamakin Wai Rukayya da rike ways at her young age. Ikon Allah,at her young age dinma babbar wayar irin black berry,wayar da se Ya'yan wane da wane suke da'ita,wayan datajima tana yearning Abbansu yasaya musu irinta anma yaki fir anma Wai yanzu Rukayya ce ke rike da'ita. Itabama wannan yafi tada Mata hankali ba,abunda yafi daga Mata hankali shine irin sacrifice dinda Lamidon yayi,shiyana rike da karamar waya ita Rukayyan tana rike da babbar tasa. Imagining kawai takeyi,if Lamido can sacrifice his blackberry haka kawai toh miye bazai bama Rukayya ba? tunda haryabata wayar da bata rokabama, wayar da ita tana kokarin mayar Masa ma anma shi cusa Mata yake.

Lallai akwai sakel....
Wannan shine tunanin da Zaheera keyi ayayinda tanufi sashin su donta kaima su Ummi rahoto.
